detail.abstract: This paper focuses on one of three kinds of social policy study areas, i.e. normative (evaluative and/or prescriptive) social policy. The others are descriptive and explanatory social policy. In doing so, this paper puts forward a macro evaluation of standard social policy solutions, and on top of that offers new social policy solutions, as well as entire social policy strategies and new fields and methods for the social policy profession to engage in, plus the reasons for doing so. This study breaks tradition in social policy as far as it obliterates the believe that asset and means-testing is a good thing (as still most professionals and experts in the field of social policy hold and defend that particular view). The paper proposes the abandonment of all asset- and means-testing, as commonly known, and their replacement with non-economic targeting methods and/or universal benefits and services, in their entirety.

detail.abstract: The pathway followed by the Korean welfare state is particularly interesting: some forms of welfare provision originated during the authoritarian period, but mostly aiming at obtaining political legitimation and public support. However, the situation began to change with the end of the military regime and the restoration of a parliamentary republic in 1987. The beginning of the democratization process – and the election of Kim Young Sam, the first civilian President of the country – marked a significant point in the expansion of the Korean welfare state. This expansion, and possible consolidation, was – strangely enough – nurtured immediately in the wake of the Asian economic crisis, under the new Presidency of Kim Dae Jung. In this paper, the authors give an account of the development of Korean welfare state focusing in particular on the post-crisis period, and demonstrate how the financial crisis has been indeed an opportunity to improve welfare state’s conditions as direct outcome of democratization and globalization processes.

detail.abstract: Today, we understand that the comparative study of welfare state systems, and in particular social security systems, is not developed a great deal in global perspective. But it is also true that the existing body of knowledge on comparative study of welfare state systems is out of date, even in the heartlands of Europe. This study evaluates, first and foremost, the system structure of two leading welfare state systems in Europe: Switzerland and Austria. The authors of this paper come to the conclusion that the Swiss welfare state while being stable with regard to its institutional structures continuously increased social spending to become a leading welfare state in Europe. Austria, conversely, made through a different development, it reshaped its institutions, particularly in pensions and general universal welfare - hence, emerging as a new leader in terms of universalism in social security in the Continental regime of welfare state systems.

affiliations: Independent, ICMA Centre, Henley Business School, University of Reading and ICMA Centre - Henley Business School, University of Reading

detail.title: Flood Risk and (Un)Insurability: Evidence from the Housing Market
detail.abstract: Using home insurance policy-level data from 2009 to 2024, we study how premiums and coverage respond to properties' exposure to flood risk. We find that when a property experiences a local flood event in the previous year, the probability that flood cover is excluded rises by around 15 percentage points. Using the UK as a case study, we provide evidence that government-industry risk-sharing arrangements for flood insurance can reduce gaps in both premiums and coverage between higher-and lower-risk areas. Prior to the introduction of such an arrangement, homes in higher-risk areas paid 12% higher premiums and were 35-40 percentage points more likely to face flood exclusions than otherwise similar homes in low-risk areas. While the premium gap narrows substantially following the reform, flood exclusion rates in higher-risk areas remain persistently higher.

detail.title: Social Welfare in Macau — Between East and West: A Comparative, Analytical Welfare Regime Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper examines the Macau welfare model. Having experienced a structural shift in its economic development, establishing a Casino-based economy, Macau has yet to develop an adequate social security system. This paper examines the history, and particularly the recent period since the Handover to Chinese authorities in 1999, of the welfare system in Macau, and compares the current state of the welfare system with that of neighboring countries and territories. The paper concludes that Macau is not a typical member of the East Asian family of welfare state system, nor does it reveal strong similarties with its former mother country, Portugal. Macau has yet to embrace the concept of welfare and wellbeing as a central part of social harmony and policy making. As a result, Macau could learn plenty of lessons from other East Asian city states, like Hong Kong or Singapore, or from its new motherland, Mainland China, who all combine fast economic growth with decent (and expanding) levels of social security and social investment in education and health care.

title: From Techne Equalisation to Phronesis Premium: Generative AI and Seniority Bias in Ageing Europe

detail.title: From Techne Equalisation to Phronesis Premium: Generative AI and Seniority Bias in Ageing Europe
detail.abstract: Contrary to the prevailing view that older workers are disadvantaged by or unable to keep pace with technological change, this paper argues that generative AI may advantage them at the expense of younger ones. The mechanism operates through two channels. First, generative AI equalises procedural competence (techne) across occupations and within the same occupation and task, enabling average and lower-performing workers to reach the quality of top performers, an executional prosthesis that recovers skills depreciated with age. Second, as execution becomes cheap and replicable, the scarce factor shifts to skills that AI cannot easily replicate yet, such as contextual judgment and responsible decision-making (phronesis), capabilities that correlate with reflective experience and age rather than with technical currency. The seniority bias finds support in an empirical exercise on Eurostat EU-LFS data (2008-2025): the youth employment share in high-AI-adoption sectors diverges sharply downward after the diffusion of ChatGPT, following fifteen years of no statistically significant differential trend relative to the rest of the economy, while the senior share expands. In ageing Europe, this mechanism offers a partial response to demographic contraction. It carries, however, significant downsides, some inherent to the equalising effect itself (the devaluation of top performers, convergence toward good enough, the raising of the performance bar) and others to the revaluation of phronesis (the erosion of the training pipeline through which future judgment is formed). The advantage is transitory and self-undermining, depending on technological advancement, shifting social expectations, and the self-erosion of the very conditions that sustain it; in addition, its scope is shaped by the design choices of AI producers. The policy debate should focus on two questions: how to harness the benefits of the equalising effect and the recovery of phronesis while they last, while counteracting their adverse consequences, and how to preserve human relevance in AI-governed systems.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统观点，认为生成式AI可能使年长工作者受益而非受损，通过两个机制：1) 技术能力均等化，让普通工作者达到顶尖水平；2) 稀缺技能转向AI难以复制的经验判断力。实证数据显示高AI采用行业的青年就业份额下降，年长者份额上升。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何影响不同年龄工作者的相对优势？具体而言，AI是否可能使年长工作者受益，而非传统认为的使他们处于劣势？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两个核心概念：techne（技术能力）和phronesis（实践智慧/情境判断力）。AI均等化techne，同时提升phronesis的价值，后者与经验和年龄正相关。
AI.method: 使用Eurostat EU-LFS数据（2008-2025年）进行实证分析，比较高AI采用行业与整体经济的青年和年长就业份额趋势，特别关注ChatGPT扩散前后的变化。
AI.findings: 1) ChatGPT扩散后，高AI采用行业的青年就业份额显著下降，而年长就业份额上升；2) 此前15年无显著差异趋势；3) AI通过均等化技术能力和提升经验判断力价值，创造了年长优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战"技术变革损害年长工作者"的传统观点；2) 提出AI可能创造"年长优势"的新理论框架；3) 区分techne和phronesis在AI时代的不同价值轨迹。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为老龄化社会提供应对人口收缩的部分解决方案；2) 指出AI优势的暂时性和自我削弱特性；3) 提出政策应关注如何利用均等化效应和phronesis复苏，同时应对负面影响。

title: Improving e-scooter safety through kinematic data-based event detection
affiliations: RWTH Aachen University, RWTH Aachen University, Delft University of Technology, RWTH Aachen University, Technische Universität München (TUM), RWTH Aachen University and RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: Improving e-scooter safety through kinematic data-based event detection
detail.abstract: The growing popularity of e-scooters as a micro-mobility option has been accompanied by increased safety risks. Multiple studies highlight the impact of infrastructure on e-scooter riders during safety-critical events, emphasizing the need to identify locations where such incidents occur. However, from a preventive perspective on traffic safety, it is essential to identify these locations before an e-scooter crash occurs. This paper takes the first step towards this by proposing a novel methodology that utilizes machine learning and kinematic data from e-scooters. A comprehensive procedure is designed to prepare a labeled dataset from naturalistic e-scooter rides. Then, techniques for filtering sensor noise and extracting machine learning features are discussed. Finally, machine learning algorithms are trained and evaluated using appropriate performance metrics. Across multiple metrics, the ensemble models outperformed traditional classification algorithms, with XGBoost achieving the best overall performance. These validated models, when combined with GPS signals, can detect safety-critical events and then help identify locations associated with e-scooter infrastructure where such events occur.

title: Learning How To Borrow in a Fintech World: Consumer Behavior When Search Costs Are (Near) Zero
affiliations: and

detail.title: Learning How To Borrow in a Fintech World: Consumer Behavior When Search Costs Are (Near) Zero
detail.abstract: Online loan marketplaces are changing consumer lending. Here we investigate consumer behavior in these markets with near-zero search costs. Using administrative data on 730,000 applications, 750,000 offers, and 200,000 individuals, together with credit registry records, we document four facts. First, substantial within-applicant dispersion in offered terms makes search highly valuable. Second, marketplace nudges mitigate choice complexity. Third, applicants search significantly, applying repeatedly, asking for different terms, and rejecting offers, in ways consistent with their creditworthiness. Fourth, dynamic adverse selection constrains search, as lenders penalize repeat applicants. Our findings highlight trade-offs between informational gains from search, and reputational and cognitive costs.

title: Managing Solar–Battery Use Under Uncertainty: Prosumer Risk Preferences Across Gains and Losses
affiliations: Hasselt University, University of Antwerp and Hasselt University

detail.title: Managing Solar–Battery Use Under Uncertainty: Prosumer Risk Preferences Across Gains and Losses
detail.abstract: Power-system benefits from residential solar–battery systems are amplified when many households sell stored electricity to the grid during peak hours under centralized coordination. However, the revenues from such arrangements are inherently uncertain and evaluated differently when given as potential gains or avoided losses. To examine this type of decision-making, we conduct a split-sample discrete choice experiment (n=1,027), administering gain- and loss-domain surveys to Belgian subsamples that are representative by age, gender, and region. In each survey, respondents choose between guaranteed bill savings from self-consumption and probabilistic revenues from energy-selling agreements managed either by the household or an external actor. We observe two behavioral patterns that are central to cumulative prospect theory: overweighting of small probabilities and diminishing sensitivity to value changes relative to a reference point. This latter pattern is consistent with the reflection effect—risk aversion in gains and risk preference in losses—as reinforced by respondents being more likely to choose the guaranteed outcome when evaluating gains rather than losses. Beyond this gain–loss reference effect, our results show that households are more willing to enter energy-selling agreements when they can delegate dispatch decisions to established institutions such as energy retailers and system operators, rather than a private aggregator or self-management. Together, the observed diminishing sensitivity, probability weighting, and manager preferences—along with their variation across age and education profiles—reveal targeted and complementary policy levers. These include downside guarantees and incentive-compatible billing structures designed to reduce perceived risk and expand participation in coordinated energy-selling programs.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过离散选择实验发现，家庭在太阳能电池系统参与电网协调时，决策行为符合累积前景理论：对小概率事件过度加权，对价值变化的敏感性递减（反射效应）。此外，家庭更愿意将调度决策委托给能源零售商等机构，而非私人聚合商或自我管理。
AI.research_question: 家庭在太阳能电池系统参与电网协调时，如何在不同收益框架（潜在收益vs避免损失）下做出决策？哪些因素影响他们参与能源销售协议的意愿？
AI.motivation: 住宅太阳能电池系统在集中协调下向电网售电能带来系统效益，但相关收益具有不确定性，且人们在评估潜在收益和避免损失时存在决策差异。理解这些行为模式对设计有效的能源政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 累积前景理论（Cumulative Prospect Theory），特别是概率加权函数和反射效应（风险厌恶在收益域，风险偏好损失域）。
AI.method: 分样本离散选择实验（n=1,027），对比利时代表性样本（按年龄、性别、地区分层）分别进行收益域和损失域调查。受访者在保证的电费节省（自消费）与概率性收益（能源销售协议）之间选择。
AI.findings: 1. 观察到累积前景理论的两个核心行为模式：对小概率的过度加权，以及对价值变化的敏感性递减（相对于参考点）。2. 反射效应明显：在收益域更可能选择保证结果（风险厌恶），在损失域相反。3. 家庭更愿意将调度决策委托给能源零售商和系统运营商等机构，而非私人聚合商或自我管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将累积前景理论应用于家庭能源决策领域，验证了反射效应和概率加权在能源销售协议决策中的存在，扩展了行为经济学在可持续能源转型中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了针对性的政策杠杆：1. 下行风险保障机制；2. 激励相容的计费结构设计；3. 利用机构信任（能源零售商）降低感知风险；4. 考虑年龄和教育背景差异的政策定制，以扩大协调能源销售项目的参与度。

title: Wildfire Exposure and Retail Gasoline Prices: Evidence from the 2024 Park Fire
affiliations: Michigan State University, Catholic University of the North - Department of Economics, Michigan State University - Department of Agricultural Economics and Michigan State University

detail.title: Wildfire Exposure and Retail Gasoline Prices: Evidence from the 2024 Park Fire
detail.abstract: Natural disasters often raise gasoline prices when they disrupt upstream fuel supply, but less is known about disasters that primarily disrupt local mobility and access. We examine the short-run effect of the 2024 Park Fire on retail gasoline prices in Northern California using high-frequency station-level data and a distance-based research design. Benchmark two-way fixed effects difference-in-differences estimates show that stations near the wildfire experienced price declines relative to more distant stations, with the largest effects concentrated within 10 miles of the fire perimeter. Because treated and control stations do not fully satisfy parallel pre-trends in the weekly panel, we use synthetic difference-in-differences as our preferred estimator. The SDID results confirm a negative local price response: gasoline prices fell by 2.5 cents per gallon for stations within 20 miles of the wildfire and by 3.9 cents for stations within 10 miles during the six weeks following fire onset. The effect attenuates as the post-treatment window expands and is concentrated among rural and unbranded stations. Taken together, the spatial, temporal, and heterogeneity patterns are more consistent with a localized contraction in gasoline demand than with a broad supply-driven fuel shock. More broadly, the results show that disaster-induced gasoline price responses depend on the dominant channel of disruption and are not uniformly upward.

AI.tldr: 研究2024年Park Fire对北加州零售汽油价格的短期影响，发现靠近野火的加油站价格下降而非上升，这主要源于当地需求收缩而非供应冲击
AI.research_question: 自然灾害（特别是主要破坏当地交通和可达性的灾害）如何影响零售汽油价格？
AI.motivation: 传统研究关注自然灾害对上游燃料供应的破坏导致汽油价格上涨，但对主要影响当地交通和可达性的灾害如何影响汽油价格知之甚少
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害对汽油价格的影响机制：供应冲击（价格上涨）vs. 需求收缩（价格下降）
AI.method: 使用高频站点级数据，基于距离的研究设计，采用双向固定效应双重差分法，并优先使用合成双重差分法（SDID）
AI.findings: 靠近野火的加油站价格相对下降：20英里内下降2.5美分/加仑，10英里内下降3.9美分/加仑；效应随时间衰减，主要集中在农村和无品牌加油站
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了自然灾害必然导致汽油价格上涨的传统观点；2. 区分了灾害影响汽油价格的不同渠道（供应冲击vs.需求收缩）；3. 提供了灾害经济影响的空间异质性证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供灾害期间汽油价格变化的预测依据；2. 帮助加油站经营者理解灾害对当地需求的影响；3. 为应急管理提供经济影响评估参考

title: Housing Costs and Fertility: Evidence from Nonlinear Affordability Thresholds
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Yuan Ze University

detail.title: Housing Costs and Fertility: Evidence from Nonlinear Affordability Thresholds
detail.abstract: This paper reexamines the relationship between housing costs and fertility by addressing measurement bias and nonlinear effects in housing affordability. Standard rent-to-income measures may be mechanically endogenous, as childbirth can reduce household income and inflate affordability ratios. To overcome this issue, we measure housing costs using monthly rent levels. Using approximately 1.8 million renter observations from the American Community Survey, we estimate a threshold model to assess whether the effect of housing costs varies across affordability regimes. We identify a statistically significant rent threshold that separates two distinct regimes. Below the threshold, increases in rent are associated with economically meaningful reductions in the probability of childbirth. Above the threshold, the marginal effect becomes small and statistically indistinguishable from zero. To address potential endogeneity in housing costs, we exploit exogenous variation in local rents and find consistent evidence of this nonlinear pattern. Additional analyses show that the threshold effect is strongest among women aged 30-34, corresponding to peak childbearing years. These findings indicate that housing affordability constraints operate primarily within specific cost ranges rather than uniformly across the rent distribution. More broadly, the results highlight the importance of measurement and functional form in identifying demographic responses to housing market conditions

AI.tldr: 本文通过解决住房可负担性测量偏差和非线性效应，重新审视住房成本与生育率的关系。研究发现存在一个显著的租金阈值：低于阈值时租金上涨会显著降低生育概率，高于阈值时边际效应趋近于零。这种非线性效应在30-34岁女性中最为明显。
AI.research_question: 住房成本如何影响生育率？是否存在非线性关系，即住房可负担性约束是否只在特定成本范围内发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 传统租金收入比测量存在内生性问题（生育会降低家庭收入从而人为提高可负担性比率），需要更准确的测量方法和考虑非线性效应来理解住房成本对生育的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房可负担性理论、家庭经济学理论、阈值效应理论、非线性关系框架
AI.method: 使用美国社区调查约180万租房者观测数据，采用阈值模型分析住房成本效应在不同可负担性区制中的变化。使用月度租金水平而非租金收入比来避免内生性，并利用地方租金的外生变化进行内生性处理。
AI.findings: 识别出统计显著的租金阈值，将效应分为两个区制：低于阈值时租金增加会显著降低生育概率；高于阈值时边际效应小且统计上不显著。这种非线性效应在30-34岁女性（生育高峰期）中最为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了住房成本与生育率的非线性关系；2) 提出了更准确的住房成本测量方法；3) 发展了阈值效应理论在人口经济学中的应用；4) 强调了测量方法和函数形式在识别住房市场条件对人口反应中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为住房政策制定提供实证依据，表明住房可负担性干预应在特定成本范围内最有效；2) 帮助识别最受住房成本影响的群体（30-34岁女性）；3) 为家庭规划和人口政策提供参考；4) 改进了住房可负担性的测量实践。

title: AI Bubble Will Emerge if AI Giants Fail to Solve Two Critical Challenges AI IP Theft and AI Safety
affiliations: PCET Multimedia Education

detail.title: AI Bubble Will Emerge if AI Giants Fail to Solve Two Critical Challenges AI IP Theft and AI Safety

keywords: AI Safety Bill Gates Issues Warning on AI Investment Hype

detail.abstract: At the World Economic Forum in Davos 2026, AI industry leaders presented an exclusively optimistic vision of artificial intelligence. None addressed the mounting legal crises, government bans, or intellectual property theft scandals affecting their companies. Only Bill Gates-Microsoft founder and AI investor-warned about 'AI Investment Hype' and urged caution. This article examines two critical challenges that threaten the AI industry with a bubble collapse similar to the dot-com crash: (1) Intellectual Property Theft that blocks innovation and advancement, and (2) AI Safety Lawsuits that create a lose-lose legal trap for developers. Both problems are interconnected and, if left unsolved, make market collapse inevitable.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了AI行业面临的两大关键挑战：知识产权盗窃和AI安全诉讼，警告如果不解决这些问题，AI行业可能面临类似互联网泡沫破裂的市场崩溃风险。
AI.research_question: AI行业面临哪些关键挑战可能引发类似互联网泡沫的市场崩溃？特别是知识产权盗窃和AI安全诉讼如何相互关联并威胁行业稳定？
AI.motivation: 在2026年达沃斯世界经济论坛上，AI行业领袖只展示乐观前景，忽视日益严重的法律危机、政府禁令和知识产权盗窃丑闻。只有比尔·盖茨警告"AI投资炒作"并呼吁谨慎。这种盲目乐观与现实问题之间的脱节促使作者分析威胁AI行业稳定的根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 市场泡沫理论（特别是互联网泡沫类比）
2. 知识产权与创新理论
3. 法律风险与责任理论
4. 行业可持续发展理论
AI.method: 基于达沃斯论坛观察的定性分析，结合案例研究法分析知识产权盗窃和AI安全诉讼的具体问题，采用系统思维分析两个问题的相互关联性及其对行业稳定的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 知识产权盗窃阻碍创新和进步
2. AI安全诉讼为开发者创造了双输的法律陷阱
3. 这两个问题相互关联，如果不解决将导致市场崩溃不可避免
4. 行业领袖的盲目乐观与现实问题形成鲜明对比
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将互联网泡沫理论应用于AI行业风险分析
2. 提出知识产权盗窃与AI安全诉讼的相互强化机制理论
3. 构建AI行业系统性风险分析框架
4. 挑战AI行业过度乐观的主流叙事
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为AI投资者提供风险预警
2. 为政策制定者识别监管重点
3. 为AI公司提供风险管理建议
4. 促进行业对法律和伦理问题的重视

title: Fixed capital, labor, and carbon footprint: A redefinition of consumer responsibility
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Fixed capital, labor, and carbon footprint: A redefinition of consumer responsibility
detail.abstract: Accurate attribution of carbon emission responsibility is a prerequisite for effective global climate governance. To improve responsibility attribution, we develop an end-use environmentally extended input-output (EEIO) model that closes fixed capital and labor. The model captures emission flows overlooked in the conventional EEIO models. Specifically, it represents the circular process in which emissions embodied in fixed capital stocks and labor re-enter the production process through consumption of fixed capital and labor input. Applying this model to 164 countries and regions from 2000 to 2018, we demonstrate that it corrects systematic biases, raising high-income countries’ carbon footprints while lowering those of others. For instance, while the EEIO carbon footprint gap between China (11.42 Gt) and the United States (6.29 Gt) was large, the end-use EEIO model reveals a much narrower disparity (6.02 Gt vs 6.22 Gt). Structural Decomposition Analysis identifies the final demand scale effect as the dominant driver of global carbon footprint growth, whereas the declining carbon intensities of industries, fixed capital, and labor act as the primary mitigating forces. Moreover, the reassessment of decoupling reveals that the conventional EEIO model has overstated the progress of green transitions, particularly in developed countries. The end-use EEIO model yields a global CO₂-GDP elasticity of 0.39 compared with the conventional model’s 0.42. These findings highlight that incorporating carbon emissions embodied in fixed capital and labor in carbon footprint accounting is critical for accurate responsibility attribution and sustainable development.​

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个考虑固定资产和劳动力的终端使用环境扩展投入产出模型，修正了传统EEIO模型的系统性偏差，重新评估了各国碳责任分配，发现发达国家碳足迹被低估而发展中国家被高估。
AI.research_question: 如何通过改进碳足迹核算方法来更准确地分配全球碳排放责任？
AI.motivation: 准确的碳排放责任分配是有效全球气候治理的前提，传统环境扩展投入产出模型忽略了固定资产和劳动力中的隐含碳排放流动，导致责任分配存在系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 终端使用环境扩展投入产出理论，考虑了固定资产和劳动力的循环过程，即固定资产存量和劳动力中的隐含碳排放通过固定资产消耗和劳动力投入重新进入生产过程。
AI.method: 开发了封闭固定资产和劳动力的终端使用EEIO模型，应用于2000-2018年164个国家和地区的数据，并进行结构分解分析。
AI.findings: 1）修正了系统性偏差：提高了高收入国家碳足迹，降低了其他国家；2）中美碳足迹差距显著缩小；3）最终需求规模效应是主要驱动因素，而产业、固定资产和劳动力碳强度下降是主要缓解力量；4）传统模型高估了绿色转型进展，特别是发达国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑固定资产和劳动力隐含碳排放的终端使用EEIO模型理论框架，完善了碳足迹核算方法学，为更准确的碳排放责任分配提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的碳责任分配工具，揭示了发达国家实际碳责任被低估的问题，有助于更公平有效的全球气候治理和可持续发展政策制定。

title: Space Mining
affiliations: University of Minnesota Law School

detail.title: Space Mining

publicationDetails.detailsText: Minnesota Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-20
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Minnesota Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The Trump Administration and U.S. Congress are promoting new ventures to extract valuable minerals from outer space. This Article does not dismiss the idea out of hand, but explores reasons for caution, including practical problems with space mining, its environmental impact, the likelihood that the United States could violate international law, and the risk of armed conflict. These problems are exacerbated by financial conflicts of interest in our government with a handful of billionaires, who have a financial interest in space mining work. The promotion of their agenda could involve wasteful government spending on subsidies for private ventures, with a very uncertain return. Space mining, if it becomes economically feasible, may be inevitable, and this means that it is important to work toward multinational agreements to regulate it rather than assume that enforceable principles of international law will prohibit it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国推动太空采矿的风险，包括实际问题、环境影响、国际法冲突和武装冲突风险，并指出政府与亿万富翁的利益冲突可能导致浪费性补贴，建议应通过多边协议而非禁止来规制太空采矿。
AI.research_question: 美国推动太空采矿面临哪些风险？如何通过国际规制来应对这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府和美国国会正在推动从外太空开采有价值矿物的新企业，但这一举措存在多方面风险需要审慎评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法框架、环境伦理、冲突理论、公共政策分析、利益冲突理论。
AI.method: 政策分析、法律分析、风险评估、案例研究。
AI.findings: 太空采矿面临实际问题、环境影响、国际法违反风险、武装冲突风险；政府与亿万富翁的利益冲突可能导致浪费性补贴；太空采矿若经济可行可能不可避免，需要多边协议而非禁止。
AI.theory_contributions: 为太空资源开发提供了综合风险评估框架；探讨了国际法在太空采矿中的适用性；分析了利益冲突对公共政策的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议通过多边国际协议规制太空采矿；警示政府补贴的风险；提出避免国际冲突的规制路径。

title: Cross-Border Spillover Effects of Marijuana Dispensaries on Child Protective Services
affiliations: Northwestern University

detail.title: Cross-Border Spillover Effects of Marijuana Dispensaries on Child Protective Services
detail.abstract: I estimate the cross-border spillover effects of legalized recreational marijuana dispensaries on child protective services (CPS) reporting in a neighboring prohibition state. While existing research focuses on effects within legalizing states, little is known about impacts on neighboring prohibition states. Exploiting spatial and temporal variation in proximity to dispensaries in Wisconsin following legalization in neighboring Michigan and Illinois, I estimate that a 100-mile reduction in distance increases CPS report rates by 7 percent for children under age 13. Effects are concentrated among reports from non-mandated reporters, children with prior CPS involvement, and neglect allegations. The findings highlight the importance of interstate coordination in drug policy, clear CPS screening guidance, and supportive services for families affected by substance use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了娱乐性大麻合法化对邻近禁止州儿童保护服务报告率的跨境溢出效应。研究发现，距离合法化州大麻店每减少100英里，13岁以下儿童的CPS报告率增加7%。
AI.research_question: 娱乐性大麻合法化对邻近禁止州儿童保护服务报告率有何跨境溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注大麻合法化对合法化州内部的影响，但对邻近禁止州的跨境影响知之甚少。理解这种溢出效应对于制定有效的州际毒品政策和儿童保护措施至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间经济学和公共政策溢出效应理论，研究毒品政策变化对邻近地区的跨境影响。关注大麻可及性增加可能导致的家庭物质滥用问题及其对儿童福利的影响。
AI.method: 利用威斯康星州在密歇根州和伊利诺伊州大麻合法化后的时空变异，采用准实验设计，分析距离大麻店的远近与CPS报告率之间的关系。
AI.findings: 距离大麻店每减少100英里，13岁以下儿童的CPS报告率增加7%。效应主要集中在非强制报告者、有先前CPS介入史的儿童以及忽视指控方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了大麻合法化对邻近禁止州的跨境溢出效应，扩展了毒品政策影响的地理边界，为州际政策协调提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了州际毒品政策协调的重要性，建议制定清晰的CPS筛查指南，并为受物质滥用影响的家庭提供支持服务。

title: Economic Policy Instruments for Innovative Growth In The European Union - The Case of AI
affiliations: University of National and World Economy, Bulgaria

detail.title: Economic Policy Instruments for Innovative Growth In The European Union - The Case of AI

declarations.funderStatement: Funded by the University of National and World Economy, BULGARIA

detail.abstract:
The recent economic (USA tariffs) and geopolitical (conflict in Ukraine) developments are creating a host of challenges for the EU, at a time when a new wave of high technology is intensifying EU's economic competition with the U.S. and China. In the last 15 years, the European economy has been lagging in both the quantitative and qualitative characteristics of growth compared with its two main rivals. Therefore, the enhancement of the EU's technological and product innovation capabilities is of critical importance for its future positions in the global marketplace. 
This research focuses on the selection of adequate economic policy instruments for the establishment of an investment, R&D, and institutional environment that will enhance innovation processes in the EU, with a focus on artificial intelligence (AI)-where, currently, the EU lags behind the USA and China. An in-depth analysis outlines the key factors behind the lag and proposes specific mechanisms and instruments for catching up.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨欧盟如何通过选择合适的经济政策工具来提升创新能力，特别是在人工智能领域追赶美国和中国。
AI.research_question: 欧盟应选择哪些经济政策工具来建立投资、研发和制度环境，以增强其创新能力，特别是在人工智能领域追赶美国和中国？
AI.motivation: 近期经济（美国关税）和地缘政治（乌克兰冲突）发展给欧盟带来挑战，同时新技术浪潮加剧了欧盟与美中的经济竞争。过去15年，欧盟在增长的数量和质量特征上都落后于主要竞争对手，因此提升欧盟的技术和产品创新能力对其在全球市场的未来地位至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新政策理论、追赶理论、技术差距理论、制度经济学、产业政策理论。
AI.method: 深入分析（in-depth analysis），识别欧盟在人工智能领域落后的关键因素，并提出具体的追赶机制和工具。
AI.findings: 研究将识别欧盟在人工智能领域落后的关键因素，并提出具体的政策机制和工具来帮助欧盟追赶美国和中国。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创新政策理论提供实证支持，特别是在追赶情境下的政策工具选择理论，丰富技术差距和追赶理论的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供具体的政策建议和工具，帮助建立有利于创新的投资、研发和制度环境，特别是在人工智能领域实现追赶。

title: AI and Social Policy

detail.title: AI and Social Policy
detail.abstract: This paper analyses the downsides of AI for policymaking, and social policy, in general. Human intelligence may depend on artificial intelligence, but artificial intelligence can only come from human intelligence. With AI, knowledge is only averaged and selected, from old and new knowledge, from good and bad (empirically not supported/counterfactual and counterproductive) knowledge. There are new opportunities with AI, especially in research, but the downsides (e.g. technological unemployment due to AI) are super massive and super consequential for the well-being and the future of humanity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了AI在政策制定和社会政策中的负面影响，指出AI知识只是新旧、好坏知识的平均和选择，虽然AI带来研究新机遇，但其负面影响（如AI导致的技术性失业）对人类的福祉和未来具有超级巨大和深远的影响。
AI.research_question: AI在政策制定和社会政策中有哪些负面影响？这些影响如何威胁人类的福祉和未来？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI在研究和政策制定中提供了新机遇，但其潜在的负面后果（特别是技术性失业）对人类社会的福祉和未来发展构成了巨大威胁，需要深入分析和警示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人工智能与人类智能的辩证关系理论，探讨AI知识的局限性（只是已有知识的平均和选择），以及技术决定论视角下AI对社会政策的深远影响。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论论证，通过对AI知识本质的哲学分析和对社会政策影响的逻辑推理，揭示AI在政策制定中的潜在风险。
AI.findings:
1. AI知识存在根本性局限：只是对已有知识的平均和选择，无法产生真正创新
2. AI可能导致大规模技术性失业，对社会稳定和人类福祉造成超级巨大的负面影响
3. AI在政策制定中的应用可能放大现有知识的偏见和错误
4. 人类智能与AI之间存在相互依赖但不对称的关系
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了AI知识的"平均选择"理论，解释了AI在知识创造上的根本局限
2. 发展了AI与社会政策关系的辩证分析框架
3. 深化了对技术性失业理论的理解，强调AI带来的失业问题的特殊性和严重性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 警示政策制定者谨慎使用AI工具，避免过度依赖
2. 为AI治理和政策制定提供风险预警框架
3. 呼吁社会重视AI带来的就业冲击，提前制定应对策略
4. 促进对AI技术发展的伦理反思和社会责任讨论

title: Evaluating the Performance of Provident Fund Systems: The Case of Singapore

detail.title: Evaluating the Performance of Provident Fund Systems: The Case of Singapore

publicationDetails.detailsText: chapter in: Development and Social Policy (ed. by Christian Aspalter and Kenny Teguh-Pribadi, Routledge, July, 2016); ISBN-13: 978-1138186576

detail.abstract: This paper elaborates and examines the general system characteristics of the Central Provident Fund (CPF) system, the chief social security system of Singapore. Singapore has developed, over the past decades, a landmark model of a social security system that leaves individual incentives intact, and thus avoids major pitfalls of common social insurance-based social security systems. This paper demonstrates in detail the advantages of a Singaporean-style social security system, and ways how to improve it further. The experience and performance of the CPF-based Singaporean social security system, on top, is being intensively compared to the performance of other types of social security systems, particularly social insurance systems (both Bismarckian and Beveridgean).

AI.tldr: 本文详细阐述和检验了新加坡中央公积金（CPF）系统作为主要社会保障体系的一般系统特征。新加坡在过去几十年发展出了一个具有里程碑意义的社会保障模式，该模式保持个人激励完整，避免了基于社会保险的常见社会保障体系的主要缺陷。
AI.research_question: 新加坡中央公积金（CPF）系统作为社会保障体系的一般系统特征是什么？与其他类型的社会保障体系（特别是俾斯麦式和贝弗里奇式社会保险体系）相比，其表现如何？
AI.motivation: 新加坡发展出了一个独特的社会保障模式，该模式保持了个人激励，避免了传统社会保险体系的常见问题。研究这一模式的特征和优势，可以为其他国家提供借鉴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会保障体系理论，特别是比较不同社会保障模式（如俾斯麦式社会保险、贝弗里奇式社会保险与公积金模式）的理论框架。
AI.method: 系统特征分析，比较研究方法，详细阐述CPF系统的运作机制，并与其他社会保障体系进行深入比较。
AI.findings: 新加坡CPF系统具有保持个人激励、避免传统社会保险体系缺陷的优势。该系统在多个方面表现优于俾斯麦式和贝弗里奇式社会保险体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社会保障体系理论提供了新加坡公积金模式的新视角，丰富了社会保障模式的比较研究，提出了保持个人激励的社会保障体系设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家设计或改革社会保障体系提供了新加坡模式的具体经验和改进建议，展示了如何构建既保障社会安全又保持经济激励的社会保障制度。

title: Tariffs in a Multi-Player Economy
affiliations: University of Akron - The George W. Daverio School of Accountancy

detail.title: Tariffs in a Multi-Player Economy
detail.abstract: This Article argues that tariffs cannot be understood through border mechanics or political slogans alone. In a multi-player economy, tariffs operate through interconnected supply chains, pricing structures, strategic dependencies, and allied relationships, which means their effects rarely remain confined to the intended foreign target. The familiar claim that "they pay" therefore obscures the more difficult question of economic incidence, which often falls substantially on domestic importers, firms, and consumers. More broadly, the Article contends that tariff policy cannot be evaluated in the abstract. Whether a tariff is defensible depends on the objective being pursued, whether revenue, coercion, resilience, or industrial adjustment, and on a candid account of burdens, time horizon, strategic sectors, and allied spillovers. The Article concludes by proposing a disciplined framework for evaluating tariff policy as strategy rather than political posture.

AI.tldr: 本文认为关税不能仅通过边境机制或政治口号来理解。在多玩家经济中，关税通过相互关联的供应链、定价结构、战略依赖和盟友关系运作，其影响很少局限于预期的外国目标。"他们支付"的常见说法掩盖了更复杂的经济归宿问题，负担往往大量落在国内进口商、企业和消费者身上。更广泛地说，关税政策不能抽象评估，其合理性取决于追求的目标（收入、胁迫、韧性或产业调整）以及对负担、时间范围、战略部门和盟友溢出效应的坦诚考量。
AI.research_question: 如何正确理解和评估关税政策的经济影响和合理性？关税的真实经济归宿是什么？如何建立一个有效的框架来评估关税作为战略工具而非政治姿态的价值？
AI.motivation: 当前对关税的理解过于简化，要么关注边境机制，要么停留在政治口号层面。这种简化忽视了关税在复杂全球经济中的实际运作方式，导致对"谁真正支付关税"的错误认知，以及缺乏评估关税政策有效性的系统框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 供应链经济学：关税通过相互关联的供应链传播影响；2. 经济归宿理论：分析税收负担的实际分配；3. 战略贸易理论：关税作为战略工具而非单纯保护主义；4. 全球价值链理论：考虑跨国生产网络中的关税影响。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，基于经济学原理和国际贸易理论，通过逻辑推理和概念分析，提出评估关税政策的系统性框架。
AI.findings: 1. 关税影响很少局限于目标国家，通过供应链传导到国内经济；2. "他们支付"的说法具有误导性，关税负担往往落在国内进口商、企业和消费者身上；3. 关税政策不能抽象评估，必须考虑具体目标和情境；4. 需要区分关税作为收入工具、胁迫手段、产业调整政策或韧性战略的不同逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了超越简化理解的关税分析框架；2. 强调了经济归宿在关税分析中的核心地位；3. 将关税政策重新概念化为战略工具而非政治姿态；4. 建立了考虑目标、负担分配、时间范围和盟友关系的评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更现实的关税影响评估工具；2. 帮助识别关税政策的真实成本和收益分配；3. 提供了评估不同关税目标（收入、胁迫、韧性、产业调整）的系统方法；4. 促进更透明、负责任的关税政策制定。

title: AI to Quantum Computation: From Third Modernity to Fourth Modernity in the Beckian Sense and the Response of Social Policy

detail.title: AI to Quantum Computation: From Third Modernity to Fourth Modernity in the Beckian Sense and the Response of Social Policy
detail.abstract: This article has looked at the recent and current changes of society that were and are brought by technological changes, AI and superdigitalization in the period 2016-2025, which is now identified as Third Modernity (in the Beckian sense), and yet again by the onset of mass applications of quantum computers and quantum AI (2025-onwards), which was dubbed Fourth Modernity. The developments have been described and their effects on societal change explained. The paper also in all briefness addresses the main response that social policy could potentially come up with.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2016-2025年技术变革、AI和超数字化带来的社会变化（第三现代性），以及2025年后量子计算机和量子AI大规模应用带来的社会变革（第四现代性），并探讨了社会政策的主要应对策略。
AI.research_question: 技术变革（AI、超数字化、量子计算）如何塑造第三现代性（2016-2025）和第四现代性（2025年后）的社会结构变化？社会政策应如何应对这些变革？
AI.motivation: 当前社会正经历由技术驱动的深刻变革，需要理解这些变革对社会结构的影响，并为政策制定者提供应对策略的指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝克（Beckian）的现代性理论框架，将2016-2025年定义为第三现代性，2025年后量子技术时代定义为第四现代性。
AI.method: 描述性分析，基于对技术发展趋势和社会变革的观察与解释。
AI.findings: 技术变革（特别是AI和超数字化）正在重塑社会结构，而量子计算和量子AI的即将到来将引发更深层次的社会变革，进入第四现代性阶段。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了贝克的现代性理论，提出了第四现代性的概念框架，为理解量子技术时代的社会变革提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会政策制定者提供了应对技术驱动社会变革的指导，帮助政策制定者预见和准备量子技术时代的社会挑战。

title: Welfare State Systems in Japan and China: Past Changes and Future Challenges

detail.title: Welfare State Systems in Japan and China: Past Changes and Future Challenges
detail.abstract: This paper analyses past developments and future challenges of welfare state systems in Japan and China, comparing the two countries history in constructing and adapting their welfare state systems. The paper uses the concept of welfare state systems to better reflect particularistic features of welfare states around the world, be they large and comprehensive, or small and limited in scope. Whereas both countries will suffer severely from ageing of society, China in addition also has to cope with fast changing economic transition and its accompanying social changes, particularly domestic migration and modernization of society.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了日本和中国福利国家体系的历史发展与未来挑战，指出两国都面临人口老龄化问题，而中国还需应对快速经济转型带来的社会变迁。
AI.research_question: 日本和中国的福利国家体系在历史发展和未来挑战方面有何异同？
AI.motivation: 为了更好地理解不同福利国家体系的特定特征，无论是全面的大型体系还是有限的小型体系，并分析两国在应对社会变迁方面的不同挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利国家体系概念，用于反映世界各地福利国家的特定特征；比较福利国家理论。
AI.method: 比较历史分析方法，分析两国福利国家体系的构建和适应过程。
AI.findings: 两国都面临严重的人口老龄化挑战；中国还需应对快速经济转型、国内移民和社会现代化等额外挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了福利国家体系概念的应用，为比较不同规模和特征的福利国家提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了两国福利体系发展的经验教训，特别关注中国在快速转型时期的特殊挑战。

title: Third Modernity and Social Policy

detail.title: Third Modernity and Social Policy
detail.abstract: This paper identifies the onset of "Third Modernity" with the coming of artificial intelligence and its applications, as well as enhanced digitalization, back in the year 2016. This article emphasizes its effects on human employment, which are truly devastating in the years and decades to come. The social policy solutions to the multiple conundrums of artificial intelligence, societal aging and climate change are to be fundamental and systemic in nature. Building on decades of normative social policy research, this article puts forward three new fundamental social policy strategies that focus on (i) incentive mechanisms in social security and social assistance provision, (ii) health education and early diagnosis, as well as (iii) 'smart' targeted universal benefits and services. And in addition to that, the author predicts the coming of universal basic income schemes, in numerous developed and fast developing societies alike.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出2016年人工智能和数字化的兴起标志着"第三现代性"的开始，将对社会就业产生破坏性影响，需要根本性的社会政策改革来应对AI、社会老龄化和气候变化等多重挑战。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能、数字化、社会老龄化和气候变化等多重挑战下，社会政策应如何根本性改革以应对"第三现代性"带来的就业冲击和社会问题？
AI.motivation: 人工智能和数字化的快速发展（自2016年起）正在对就业市场产生破坏性影响，同时社会老龄化和气候变化也带来严峻挑战，需要根本性的社会政策解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"第三现代性"理论框架，结合规范社会政策研究，分析AI时代的社会变革需求。
AI.method: 规范性政策分析，基于长期社会政策研究提出理论框架和政策建议。
AI.findings: AI和数字化将严重冲击就业市场，需要三大根本性社会政策策略：1）社会保障和援助的激励机制改革；2）健康教育和早期诊断体系；3）"智能"目标性普遍福利和服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"第三现代性"概念及其社会政策理论框架，为AI时代的社会政策研究提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三大具体社会政策改革策略，并预测普遍基本收入制度将在发达和发展中社会广泛实施，为政策制定者提供实践指导。

title: Towards 'Human Capital Solidarity': Emphasizing Justice in the Distribution of Physical, Mental, Social and Cultural Capabilities - A Normative Study in Social Policy

detail.title: Towards 'Human Capital Solidarity': Emphasizing Justice in the Distribution of Physical, Mental, Social and Cultural Capabilities - A Normative Study in Social Policy
detail.abstract: The last couple of decades have seen a succession of new paradigms in social policy, particularly social security policy. Pension and health care systems have seen major, and many times systematic, changes on average every couple of years. This paper aims to introduce a new perspective to social policy that has not been pursued so far - that is, delivering social solidarity by focusing on human resources (i.e. physical, mental, social and cultural capabilities) developing the human capital solidarity approach. The human capital solidarity approach focuses on long-term lifetime perspectives and the need to achieve short-term goals; it focuses also on mental and environmental sides of social problems, rather than trying to fix every problem with a monetary solution alone. The new approach also introduces new concepts of e.g. ‘environmental social policy’, ‘cultural social policy’, and ‘social policy marketing’.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的社会政策视角——人力资本团结方法，强调通过发展人力资源（身体、心理、社会和文化能力）来实现社会团结，而不仅仅依赖货币解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何通过发展人力资源（身体、心理、社会和文化能力）来实现社会团结，从而为社会保障政策提供新的视角？
AI.motivation: 过去几十年社会政策范式频繁更迭，养老金和医疗体系平均每几年就发生系统性变化，需要一种更全面、长期的社会政策视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本团结方法，强调长期生命周期视角与短期目标平衡，关注心理和环境维度，而非单纯货币解决方案。
AI.method: 概念性论文，提出新的理论框架和分析视角，引入"环境社会政策"、"文化社会政策"和"社会政策营销"等新概念。
AI.findings: 提出了人力资本团结方法作为社会政策的新范式，强调通过发展人力资源实现社会团结，关注非经济维度，为政策制定提供更全面的框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出人力资本团结方法作为社会政策新理论框架；2. 引入环境、文化和社会政策营销等新概念；3. 扩展社会团结理论，强调人力资源发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供更全面的政策设计框架；2. 强调非经济因素在社会政策中的重要性；3. 促进长期视角与短期目标的平衡；4. 为社会保障体系改革提供新思路。

title: The Field-to-Hospital Data Gap in Disaster Response: A Persistent Failure Point in Continuity of Care and the Case for an NFC-Based Offline Patient Tracker

detail.title: The Field-to-Hospital Data Gap in Disaster Response: A Persistent Failure Point in Continuity of Care and the Case for an NFC-Based Offline Patient Tracker

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no financial relationships with any organization that could have an interest in the submitted work.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding

detail.abstract: In mass casualty events and large-scale emergencies, clinical data gathered by field providers is routinely lost before it reaches the receiving facility. Triage classification, medication administration, vital sign trends, and mechanism of injury are established at the point of first contact and transmitted verbally at handoff, if at all. Receiving teams restart without that context, repeating assessments and making treatment decisions from zero. This failure is not a product of inadequate effort or protocol adherence; it reflects structural limitations in how clinical information is captured, carried, and retained under austere conditions. Existing approaches each break down in predictable ways when infrastructure fails: networked records require connectivity that disasters destroy; paper tags degrade and detach during transport; verbal handoff produces significant information loss even under routine conditions. This paper examines the field-to-hospital data gap and the case for a patient-carried, infrastructureindependent approach to closing it. Near Field Communication (NFC) technology provides a practical mechanism: passive, battery-free tags that store structured clinical records and transmit them to any NFC-enabled smartphone without network connectivity, institutional login, or interoperability between agency systems. Attached to a patient at first clinical contact, an NFC tag carries a complete record through every subsequent handoff, readable at the receiving facility regardless of infrastructure status. The paper reviews the evidence on handoff-related patient harm, analyses the limitations of current documentation approaches in disaster settings, and makes the case for a controlled pilot study to validate NFC-based offline patient tracking in mass casualty environments. Collaboration with academic and operational partners is the necessary next step toward establishing the clinical evidence base for this approach.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨大规模伤亡事件中临床数据丢失问题，提出使用近场通信(NFC)技术作为患者携带、基础设施独立的解决方案，通过无电池标签存储临床记录，可在无网络环境下通过智能手机读取，建议开展试点研究验证该方案。
AI.research_question: 如何解决大规模伤亡事件中现场到医院的临床数据丢失问题？NFC技术能否作为有效的患者携带、基础设施独立的解决方案？
AI.motivation: 大规模伤亡事件中，现场医护人员收集的临床数据（分诊分类、用药记录、生命体征趋势、损伤机制等）在到达接收医院前经常丢失，导致接收团队需重新评估，从零开始治疗决策，这种数据丢失不是由于努力不足或协议遵守问题，而是恶劣条件下临床信息捕获、携带和保留的结构性限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息传输理论、灾难医学信息管理、临床交接质量理论、技术接受模型（针对NFC技术应用）。
AI.method: 文献综述方法：回顾交接相关患者伤害证据；分析当前灾难环境下文档记录方法的局限性；提出NFC技术作为解决方案的理论框架；建议开展控制性试点研究验证NFC离线患者追踪在大规模伤亡环境中的有效性。
AI.findings: 现有方法在基础设施失效时都会崩溃：网络化记录需要灾难中会被破坏的连接性；纸质标签在运输中会降解和脱落；口头交接即使在常规条件下也会产生显著信息丢失。NFC技术提供了一种实用机制：被动、无电池标签可存储结构化临床记录，无需网络连接、机构登录或机构系统互操作性，通过任何NFC智能手机即可读取。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了灾难医学中临床信息管理的结构性限制理论；建立了患者携带、基础设施独立的信息传输模型；为NFC技术在紧急医疗中的应用提供了理论框架；丰富了灾难医学信息学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种实用的NFC解决方案，可在无网络环境下实现临床数据连续传输；建议开展试点研究验证该技术的有效性；为应急响应机构提供了可操作的技术方案；促进了学术与操作伙伴的合作，建立该方法的临床证据基础。

title: Government Finance and Social Policy

detail.title: Government Finance and Social Policy
detail.abstract: This article explains the connection between government finance and social policy. The welfare state for many is understood as a treasure chest, an infinite source of money to be spent on for important and a great many purposes. Today, still, there are a great majority of social policy experts and professionals who do not think too much about how the money for social policies, for the welfare state system, is being spent.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨政府财政与社会政策之间的关系，指出许多社会政策专家忽视福利国家资金的来源与使用效率问题。
AI.research_question: 政府财政与社会政策之间有何内在联系？社会政策专家为何忽视福利国家资金的来源与使用效率？
AI.motivation: 福利国家常被视为取之不尽的"宝库"，但大多数社会政策专家忽视资金如何筹集和有效使用的问题，这种认知偏差需要被纠正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利国家理论、公共财政理论、社会政策分析框架
AI.method: 理论分析、文献综述、概念框架构建
AI.findings: 社会政策专家普遍存在"财政盲点"，忽视福利国家资金的财政可持续性和使用效率问题，这可能导致政策设计缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了政府财政与社会政策的整合分析框架，提出了"财政盲点"概念，丰富了福利国家理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者关注社会政策的财政可持续性，促进更有效的资源配置，提高福利国家系统的长期稳定性。
