title: The East Asian Welfare Model

detail.title: The East Asian Welfare Model

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Social Welfare, Vol. 15, pp. 290-301, 2006

detail.abstract: This article aims to outline main features of the East Asian welfare model, to understand its past development and assess lessons that can be learned for other developing and developed countries. It describes the particular path of welfare state development in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Singapore, by focusing particularly on developmental and political aspects of welfare state development. In the final part of the study, particular features of the East Asian welfare model are outlined, and thus the existence of a distinct, idealtypical welfare regime in East Asia substantiated.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了东亚福利模式的主要特征，分析其发展历程，并评估对其他发展中和发达国家的借鉴意义。
AI.research_question: 东亚福利模式的主要特征是什么？其发展路径如何？其他国家和地区可以从中学到什么？
AI.motivation: 东亚地区（日本、韩国、台湾、香港、新加坡）的福利国家发展路径具有独特性，需要系统梳理其特征和发展历程，为其他国家和地区提供借鉴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利国家理论、发展型国家理论、东亚福利模式理论
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，聚焦日本、韩国、台湾、香港和新加坡的福利国家发展，特别关注发展性和政治性方面
AI.findings: 东亚福利模式具有独特的发展路径和特征，证实了东亚存在一个独特的、理想型的福利体制
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了东亚存在一个独特的福利体制，丰富了福利国家理论，为比较福利研究提供了新的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他发展中国家和发达国家提供了东亚福利模式的经验教训，有助于各国制定适合自身国情的福利政策

title: Healthy Foods, Happy Lives

detail.title: Healthy Foods, Happy Lives
detail.abstract: This article gives a thorough introduction to the problem that causes many millions of people to die prematurely every year: unhealthy foods, unhealthy food choices and the therefrom resulting unheatlhy lifestyles of billions. Social policy needs to tackle this problem to ensure the prevention of premature/preventable losses of lives of many millions, as well as the problem of financial collapse of governments that result from a combination of factors, among which healthy foods and healthy lifestyles, or the lack thereof,  are monumentally desicive (apart from population decline, climate change, etc.). Social policy needs to focus to the utmost degree on healthy foods, healthy and happy lives.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文深入探讨了不健康食品、不健康食品选择以及由此导致的数十亿人不健康生活方式这一每年导致数百万人过早死亡的严重问题。文章强调社会政策需要解决这一问题，既要预防数百万人的过早/可预防死亡，也要应对政府财政崩溃的风险，而健康食品和健康生活方式（或缺乏这些）在其中起着决定性作用。
AI.research_question: 社会政策应如何有效应对不健康食品、不健康食品选择和不健康生活方式导致的公共卫生危机，以预防数百万人过早死亡和政府财政崩溃？
AI.motivation: 每年有数百万人因不健康食品和生活方式而过早死亡，同时这一问题还可能导致政府财政崩溃。社会政策必须优先关注健康食品和健康快乐生活，以解决这一双重危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共卫生政策理论、社会政策理论、健康经济学、预防医学理论、食品政策框架
AI.method: 理论分析、政策文献综述、公共卫生数据分析、社会经济影响评估
AI.findings: 不健康食品和生活方式是导致数百万人过早死亡的关键因素，这一问题不仅造成生命损失，还可能引发政府财政崩溃。健康食品和健康生活方式在预防这些危机中具有决定性作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将食品健康政策与社会财政稳定相结合的理论框架，强调了健康生活方式在预防公共卫生危机和政府财政危机中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优先关注健康食品和健康生活方式的政策建议，以同时应对过早死亡和政府财政崩溃的双重挑战。

title: Smart Universalism

detail.title: Smart Universalism
detail.abstract: The practice and support for universalism is rising all across the world. Social policy is experiencing a revival, away from neoliberalism, partially, at least. East Asia, South Asia, and other places (e.g. Mauritius, Slovenia, and many others) are witness for this development. Also, experts and scientists in social policy are increasingly voicing their support for universalism per se, and for more universal solutions in the field of social security and elsewhere, the many subfields of social policy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨全球范围内普遍主义社会政策的复兴趋势，分析东亚、南亚及其他地区从新自由主义转向普遍主义的社会政策实践，以及专家学者对普遍主义解决方案的支持。
AI.research_question: 全球范围内普遍主义社会政策的复兴趋势如何在不同地区（如东亚、南亚等）体现？专家学者对普遍主义解决方案的支持如何影响社会政策的发展？
AI.motivation: 观察到全球范围内普遍主义实践的兴起和社会政策从新自由主义转向的趋势，特别是在东亚、南亚等地区，以及专家学者对普遍主义解决方案的日益支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 普遍主义理论、社会政策转型理论、新自由主义批判理论、比较社会政策理论
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，分析东亚、南亚、毛里求斯、斯洛文尼亚等地区的政策实践；专家访谈和文献分析，考察学术界对普遍主义的支持态度。
AI.findings: 1. 全球普遍主义实践正在兴起，社会政策从新自由主义转向普遍主义；2. 东亚、南亚等地区成为这一转型的重要见证；3. 社会政策专家和科学家日益支持普遍主义解决方案；4. 社会保障等社会政策子领域普遍主义趋势明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了普遍主义社会政策的理论框架；2. 提供了新自由主义向普遍主义转型的理论解释；3. 拓展了比较社会政策研究的理论视角；4. 建立了专家意见与社会政策发展的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为各国社会政策制定者提供普遍主义转型的实践参考；2. 为社会保障等具体领域提供普遍主义解决方案的实践指导；3. 促进不同地区间的政策经验交流；4. 支持专家学者在社会政策改革中的实践参与。

title: Digital Health Technologies and Certified Nursing Assistants in Long-Term Care: A Scoping Review of Adoption, Barriers, and Impact on Care Quality

detail.title: Digital Health Technologies and Certified Nursing Assistants in Long-Term Care: A Scoping Review of Adoption, Barriers, and Impact on Care Quality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background: Certified nursing assistants (CNAs) represent the largest segment of direct-care staff in long-term care (LTC) facilities, providing approximately 80% to 90% of hands-on care to nursing home residents. Despite their central role, CNAs remain largely absent from digital health technology (DHT) research compared to registered nurses and physicians. This scoping review, the first to specifically examine the intersection of DHTs and the CNA workforce in LTC, aimed to map and synthesize the existing literature on DHT adoption, barriers, facilitators, and impact on care quality among CNAs.

Methods: The review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidelines and the five-stage framework proposed by Arksey and O'Malley. A systematic search was performed across four databases—PubMed, Google Scholar, CINAHL, and Scopus—for studies published between January 2015 and March 2026 that addressed CNAs or equivalent direct-care workers using any form of DHT in LTC settings. Citation tracking supplemented the database searches. Out of 542 initially identified records, 187 duplicates were removed, 355 records were screened by title and abstract, 305 were excluded, and 50 full-text reports were assessed for eligibility. Twenty-four studies met the inclusion criteria and were included in the final qualitative synthesis.

Results: Findings were organized into four thematic areas: (a) types of digital health technologies used by CNAs, with electronic health records being the most frequently studied specific technology (n = 5), followed by AI/machine learning (n = 4) and robotic systems (n = 2); eight studies examined multiple technology types; (b) barriers to technology adoption, including limited digital literacy, inadequate training programs (often 30 minutes or less), cost constraints, and the systematic exclusion of CNAs from technology design and implementation decisions; (c) facilitators of technology adoption, including perceived usefulness, hands-on training with peer mentoring, strong management support, and user-centered design that incorporates CNA input; and (d) impact on care quality, where evidence remained limited and mixed, with some studies reporting improved documentation accuracy and communication efficiency, though few directly measured resident health outcomes such as falls, pressure ulcers, or hospitalization rates. The majority of included studies (n = 20) were published after 2020, and although four studies examined AI technologies, none specifically addressed artificial intelligence in direct relation to CNA practice.

Conclusion: This review reveals a critical evidence gap and underscores the urgent need for CNA-inclusive research designs, dedicated technology training programs tailored to the unique needs of frontline direct-care workers, and policy reforms that address structural inequities in technology access. As long-term care demand intensifies amid rapid technological advancement, ensuring that CNAs are empowered, supported, and meaningfully integrated into health care's digital evolution is both a workforce imperative and a fundamental issue of care quality and health equity.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述首次系统梳理了长期护理机构中认证护理助理（CNAs）与数字健康技术（DHTs）的研究现状，发现CNAs在DHT研究中代表性严重不足，技术采用面临多重障碍，且对护理质量影响的证据有限。
AI.research_question: 长期护理机构中认证护理助理（CNAs）采用数字健康技术（DHTs）的现状、障碍、促进因素及其对护理质量的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: CNAs是长期护理机构中最大的直接护理人员群体，提供80-90%的亲手护理，但在数字健康技术研究中却严重缺席，与注册护士和医生相比代表性不足。需要了解CNAs在DHT采用中的独特挑战和机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用Arksey和O'Malley的五阶段范围综述框架，遵循PRISMA-ScR指南，系统梳理现有文献。
AI.method: 范围综述方法，系统检索PubMed、Google Scholar、CINAHL和Scopus四个数据库（2015年1月至2026年3月），通过标题/摘要筛选和全文评估，最终纳入24项研究进行定性综合。
AI.findings: 1) CNAs使用的DHT类型：电子健康记录最常见，其次是AI/机器学习和机器人系统；2) 采用障碍：数字素养有限、培训不足（常≤30分钟）、成本限制、技术设计和实施决策中排除CNAs；3) 促进因素：感知有用性、同伴指导的实践培训、管理支持、用户中心设计；4) 对护理质量的影响：证据有限且矛盾，部分研究显示文档准确性和沟通效率改善，但很少直接测量居民健康结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统梳理CNAs与DHTs的研究现状，识别了CNAs在技术采用中的结构性不平等问题，为理解前线直接护理人员的技术采用提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 呼吁CNAs包容性研究设计；2) 建议针对前线护理人员需求定制技术培训项目；3) 推动政策改革解决技术获取的结构性不平等；4) 强调在数字健康转型中赋权CNAs对护理质量和健康公平的重要性。

title: Normativity and Its Two Main Different Streams

detail.title: Normativity and Its Two Main Different Streams
detail.abstract: This article focuses on the existence of two main interpretations of normativity, i.e. what is meant by normativity in social policy, explaining their difference and hence help ensure theoretical and practical clarity. The word normative is used and (hence) thought to stand for many different things for different sciences, and for different scientists. But, in social policy, the term normative social policy should mean evaluative and/or prescriptive social policy (Pinker, 1971; Durkheim, 1928). There are different traditions and within each different streams of normative social policy theories and conceptual models. The two most fundamentally diverse groupings, or traditions, one can distinguish are, first, a philosophical tradition of normativity and, second, a pragmatic/professional consulting-oriented tradition of normative thinking and theories; in short normativity in general.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨社会政策中规范性的两种主要解释传统：哲学传统与实用/专业咨询传统，旨在澄清规范性概念的理论与实践意义。
AI.research_question: 社会政策中"规范性"概念的核心含义是什么？如何区分和理解其两种主要解释传统？
AI.motivation: "规范性"一词在不同学科和学者中有多种理解，导致概念混淆。在社会政策领域，需要明确"规范性社会政策"应指评估性和/或规定性的社会政策，以建立理论和实践上的清晰性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Pinker(1971)和Durkheim(1928)的理论，将规范性社会政策定义为评估性和/或规定性的社会政策。区分两种主要传统：1)规范性哲学传统；2)实用/专业咨询导向的规范性思维传统。
AI.method: 概念分析/理论分析方法，通过文献梳理和概念辨析来区分两种规范性传统。
AI.findings: 社会政策中存在两种根本不同的规范性传统：哲学传统（关注价值判断和伦理基础）与实用/专业咨询传统（关注实践指导和专业建议）。这两种传统代表了理解规范性的不同路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 澄清了社会政策中"规范性"概念的核心含义；2) 系统区分了两种主要的规范性传统；3) 为规范性社会政策研究提供了概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助政策制定者和实践者更清晰地理解规范性主张的性质；2) 促进不同传统间的对话和理解；3) 提升社会政策设计和评估的概念精确性。

title: Lessons for Health Care Policy in the United States: Comparing Health Care Systems

detail.title: Lessons for Health Care Policy in the United States: Comparing Health Care Systems
detail.abstract: This paper compares health care systems. It looks beyond normal academic, political, or journalistic rhetoric, by exactly sticking to facts, i.e. empirical data (in particular data provided by the WHO) and comprehensive case study analyses. The paper finds that a number of myths and common believes in health care policy are not supported by emprical evidence. Global health care policy, as well as health care policy in United States, needs to look at statistical data and profound overall assessment studies to change global health care policies. The paper reveals that there is ample room for saving costs, i.e. increase efficiency, of public health care systems in order to save lives. Good health care and more health care can be generated by 'administrative' and 'incentive' reforms (usually involving systemic and structural reforms) of health care systems. Many millions of lives can be saved if we stick to statistical empricial data and case studies, and distance ourselves from harmful ideological blindness in health care politics.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过实证数据和案例研究分析医疗系统，发现许多医疗政策中的常见观念缺乏证据支持，指出通过行政和激励改革可提高医疗系统效率、拯救生命，并呼吁基于数据而非意识形态制定政策。
AI.research_question: 不同医疗系统的实际效果如何？哪些医疗政策观念有实证支持？如何通过改革提高医疗系统效率？
AI.motivation: 超越学术、政治或新闻修辞，基于实证数据和案例研究客观比较医疗系统，纠正医疗政策中的错误观念，为政策制定提供事实基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实证主义研究框架，强调基于世界卫生组织等权威数据源和全面案例研究分析，反对意识形态偏见。
AI.method: 1. 使用WHO等机构的实证数据统计分析；2. 全面的案例研究分析；3. 事实与证据为基础的比较研究方法。
AI.findings: 1. 许多医疗政策中的神话和常见观念缺乏实证证据支持；2. 公共医疗系统存在大量节约成本、提高效率的空间；3. 通过行政和激励改革（通常涉及系统和结构改革）可以改善医疗质量和数量；4. 基于统计数据和案例研究可拯救数百万生命。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战医疗政策领域的传统观念和意识形态偏见；2. 强调实证数据在医疗政策制定中的核心地位；3. 提出基于事实的医疗系统比较分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为全球和美国医疗政策改革提供实证依据；2. 指出通过行政和激励改革提高医疗系统效率的具体路径；3. 强调基于数据决策可实际拯救生命；4. 呼吁政策制定者远离有害的意识形态盲目性。

title: Political Will and Social Policy

detail.title: Political Will and Social Policy
detail.abstract: There is no definition that fits, one that captures really what 'political will' is (cf Post and Raile, 2010; Marquette, 2020). It is a conundrum indeed, for social scientists in the political arena, it is and must be one of the greatest, if not the greatest, impediment (mystery, problem, issues, pick any one description you like). It, for me, it seems naturally the same problem as the coordination problem of Friedrich Hayek (1945, 1937, 1933). Not only is it analogous, no, it is the very same unidentified, unexplained, unsolved giant, in the theoretical castle in mainstream economics and mainstream politics alike. Collective planning/action (by all market players, by all members of society) on the one side and political will of the government, of the elites, the experts, and rank and file government officers and administrators on the other. They are obviously not the same thing, but they are explained by the same kind of forces, both of them are. For those who have had a chance, and opted for it, and pulled it through, to read my recent book on Human Entanglement Theory (2024a) or the earlier article on the same subject, on Human Quantum Mechanics (2024b), may already know what comes next.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨政治意志的本质，认为它与哈耶克的协调问题是同一理论难题，并提出人类纠缠理论作为解释框架。
AI.research_question: 政治意志的本质是什么？它如何与哈耶克的协调问题相关联？
AI.motivation: 政治意志在社会科学中缺乏明确定义，是政治领域最大的理论障碍之一，需要新的理论框架来解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈耶克的协调问题理论（1933, 1937, 1945）；人类纠缠理论（2024a）；人类量子力学（2024b）
AI.method: 理论分析，通过类比和概念比较，将政治意志问题与经济学中的协调问题联系起来。
AI.findings: 政治意志与哈耶克的协调问题本质上是同一理论难题，两者都由相似的力量驱动，尽管表现形式不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出政治意志与协调问题的理论统一性，为理解集体行动和政府决策提供新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者理解政治意志形成的机制，为解决集体行动和政府决策协调问题提供理论指导。

title: Defensive Trademark Registration: Benefits, Legal Risks, And The Position Of The Law
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Defensive Trademark Registration: Benefits, Legal Risks, And The Position Of The Law
detail.abstract:
In the world of intellectual property, trademarks are more than just symbols or logos; they are the lifeblood of a brand's identity and reputation. They serve as distinctive signposts that identify the source of goods or services and enable consumers to distinguish one enterprise from another in the marketplace. By securing exclusive rights in a mark, trademark helps businesses to protect their brand image, preserve their goodwill, and prevent unauthorised use that may cause confusion among consumers or dilute the value of their brand.[1] Trademarks have also become critical strategic assets in global commerce, particularly for companies seeking to expand internationally, and are increasingly recognised as key drivers of intangible value.

Therefore, in response to the growing commercial value of trademarks, some businesses employ a proactive strategy known as defensive trademark to further safeguard their intellectual property. This involves registering trademarks in multiple classes of goods or services, including those in which the proprietor may not have immediate commercial operations, with the aim of preventing competitors from registering identical or similar marks and exploiting the brand’s reputation.[2] While defensive trademark registration can offer valuable protection and strategic advantages, it also presents legal, financial, and regulatory challenges, particularly in jurisdictions where trademark rights are tied to bona fide use. In this article, the advantages and disadvantages of defensive trademark registration, as well as the legal position on this practice, are critically examined.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地探讨了防御性商标注册的利弊及其法律立场，分析了在商标商业价值日益增长的背景下，企业为保护品牌而采取的防御性注册策略所面临的法律、财务和监管挑战。
AI.research_question: 防御性商标注册的优缺点是什么？不同司法管辖区对这种做法的法律立场如何？
AI.motivation: 商标作为品牌身份和声誉的核心，已成为全球商业中的关键战略资产。随着商标商业价值的增长，企业采用防御性商标注册策略来保护知识产权，但这种做法也带来了法律、财务和监管方面的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权理论、商标法理论、品牌管理理论、战略资产理论
AI.method: 批判性分析法、法律分析、案例研究
AI.findings: 防御性商标注册可以提供有价值的保护和战略优势，但在商标权利与真实使用挂钩的司法管辖区，这种做法面临法律、财务和监管挑战。需要平衡保护品牌与防止商标滥用之间的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对防御性商标注册策略的理论理解，探讨了商标保护与商业实践之间的理论张力，为知识产权管理理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了关于防御性商标注册的实践指导，帮助企业在不同司法管辖区制定合理的商标保护策略，平衡保护需求与合规要求。

title: Thought Experiments in Social Policy Analysis

detail.title: Thought Experiments in Social Policy Analysis
detail.abstract: They serve different purposes and are of different kinds. Thought experiments, by and large, are a technique within theory building, theory promoting and/or theory debating. A great deal of unimaginable, previously unthought (by most), hard to understand, and unknowingly and/or stubbornly wrongly understood (by and large) conclusions are the goal of thought experiments. Sometimes the intended audience of thought experiments are the researchers/theory builders themselves, often the general scientific and/or public audience is targeted. The history of thought experiments is probably as old as imagination, religion, stories told, actions planned and simply profound, complex and comprehensive thoughts are spun.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨思想实验的本质、目的和历史，将其定位为理论构建、理论推广和理论辩论中的一种技术手段。
AI.research_question: 思想实验的本质是什么？它们在理论构建、推广和辩论中扮演什么角色？思想实验的目标受众是谁？思想实验的历史渊源如何？
AI.motivation: 思想实验在科学和哲学中广泛使用，但对其本质、目的和历史的系统性分析不足，需要澄清思想实验在不同理论活动中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 思想实验理论、科学方法论、认知科学、科学哲学中的理论构建框架。
AI.method: 概念分析、历史考察、理论推理、案例研究。
AI.findings: 思想实验是理论构建、推广和辩论的技术手段；旨在产生难以想象、难以理解或纠正错误理解的新结论；目标受众包括研究者自身和更广泛的科学/公众群体；历史渊源可追溯至想象力、宗教、故事讲述和复杂思维活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化思想实验的分类和功能；明确思想实验在科学方法论中的地位；为思想实验研究提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助研究者更有效地设计和运用思想实验；促进科学教育和公众理解科学；为跨学科研究提供方法论指导。

title: The Underbelly of Science: Caught Between Untenability and Meaninglessness

detail.title: The Underbelly of Science: Caught Between Untenability and Meaninglessness
detail.abstract: Most people never care, most people never get to care. They do not read those papers, they do not open those books. Science if full of them, in fact, John Ioannidis (2005) proclaimed in some parts of the science park they make up the majority of studies out there that run under the banner of science, that claim, pretend or the very most just imitate science (cf also Ioannidis, 2014, 2021, 2024; Ioannidis et al., 2017). Let's do aside with name calling, let's not fall into the Popperian fallacy of calling names, of science and non-science (Popper, 1959, 2007, 2009). There are though different degrees of qualities of scientific studies conducted, ranging from zero quality (zero truth, zero excellence) to maximum quality (maximum truth, maximum excellence). Mises (1940/1949) famously called these zero, to not close to any meaningful or not close to any acceptable, quality studies and publications, their theories and findings, "untenable". A very polite, and sophisticated nevertheless, phrasing of the problem: untenable. This means it cannot be held up, it needs to be disregarded, discarded (into the bin that usually stands in the corner of one's office). In general it is really difficult, I think (i.e. with a high probability, but far from certain) for all of us, or at least the very most of us, to come up with meaningful research goals plus meaningful research methods, and yet also meaningful research findings all the time, or again and again. But, this is the beauty of science, not all is given, one has to put in effort, sometimes decades of efforts, sometimes (many times) things are in vain, for good reason, science is hard, science is supposed to be really meaningful, and it is really hard to be really meaningful, for most research fields, topics, and chosen research problems, given the lack of data, or experiments, the lack of full theoretical (e.g. causal) understanding, lack of time and money, and so forth. For science to be entering the field of meaningfulness, and at the same time leaving the field of untenability, it needs to fulfill (follow) key imperatives.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了科学研究质量差异问题，从"站不住脚"到"卓越"的质量谱系，并提出了使科学研究变得有意义、摆脱站不住脚状态的关键要求。
AI.research_question: 如何区分科学研究的不同质量层次？什么关键要求能使科学研究从"站不住脚"状态进入"有意义"领域？
AI.motivation: 科学研究中存在大量质量低劣甚至"站不住脚"的研究，这些研究虽然打着科学的旗号，但缺乏真实性和卓越性。Ioannidis等人的研究显示这类研究在某些科学领域甚至占多数，需要建立质量评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ioannidis的科学可重复性危机理论、Popper的科学哲学（科学vs非科学划分）、Mises的"站不住脚"理论，构建科学研究质量谱系理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究，通过文献综述和哲学分析探讨科学研究质量评估的理论基础。
AI.findings: 科学研究质量存在从零质量（零真实性、零卓越性）到最高质量的连续谱系；"站不住脚"的研究需要被摒弃；科学要变得有意义需要满足特定的关键要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了科学研究质量谱系理论，超越了简单的科学/非科学二分法；发展了"站不住脚"研究的概念框架；识别了科学研究进入有意义领域的关键要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科研评估提供质量区分框架；帮助研究者识别和避免"站不住脚"的研究实践；为科研机构和资助机构提供质量评估标准。

title: Nudging Is Bullying

detail.title: Nudging Is Bullying
detail.abstract: The new hype of nudging in public policy and economics needs to come to an end. Nudging, in terms of outcomes (not intentions) is bullying! This is unethical to the core, and scientists and practitionners are already changing their attitudes. Buzzwords, and buzz concepts, are dangerous, when accepted unchecked!

AI.tldr: 这篇论文批判了行为经济学中的"助推"概念，认为从结果而非意图来看，助推实际上是一种霸凌行为，本质上是不道德的，呼吁结束对助推的过度炒作。
AI.research_question: 助推在公共政策和经济中的应用是否在伦理上存在问题？从结果而非意图的角度看，助推是否等同于霸凌？
AI.motivation: 当前公共政策和经济学领域对"助推"概念的过度炒作和盲目接受，可能导致不道德的政策实践，需要对此进行批判性反思。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、伦理哲学、公共政策理论、权力关系理论
AI.method: 概念分析、伦理批判、文献综述、理论论证
AI.findings: 从结果而非意图的角度分析，助推实际上是一种霸凌行为，本质上是不道德的；科学家和实践者已经开始改变对助推的态度；不加批判地接受流行概念是危险的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从结果而非意图的角度重新审视助推的伦理框架；挑战了行为经济学中助推的正当性；为公共政策伦理提供了新的批判视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁政策制定者重新评估助推策略的伦理影响；提醒学术界和实践界对流行概念保持批判性态度；促进公共政策领域的伦理反思。

title: The Interplay between Different Streams of Social Policy Theory

detail.title: The Interplay between Different Streams of Social Policy Theory
detail.abstract: A very good description of the problems of the interplay between different streams of social policy theory is given by Modood and Favell (2003), as well as Bauböck (2008). They discussed the key problems that arise from e.g., as in a (shockingly) large number of cases, working on social policy description (case studies, thematic papers, historical/ourstorical papers, etc.) and casually adding normative lessons or suggestions. Or conducting blindly descriptive social policy research projects or research works without knowing (as in most cases, as there are barely social policy-own normative theories), or not understanding normative social policy theory (having not fully read them, as so often, or simply not having gotten the gist of things, or not yet). Also, running evaluations and prescriptions (normativity-based social policy research projects and research studies) without fully knowing the empirical reality on the ground, is a monster-sized problem in social policy science, as most studies and books concentrate only on a very small number of countries (and that among Western countries). Global multicenter case studies are yet super seldom, and they themselves represent a very good starting point in analyzing and conquering (intellectually, and scientifically that is) the whole world-with all the people in it, in all countries, in all corners (on all plains, in all valleys, on all mountains, on all islands)-within the realm and discipline of social policy. Medical science and the field of health policy is a head of social policy science in applying multicenter social policy analyses. If one looks for it there are a larger number of multicenter case studies in social policy, but they are only a tiny fraction of all case studies, and yet not fully noticed, with their great value not yet fully appreciated far and wide. The great usefulness of such studies is shown e.g. by Wong and Ho (2023) when analyzing the impact and response measures to the Covid-19 Pandemic in several cities around the world, going both deep and wide, as is the winning formula of multicenter case study analysis. Quantitative global local data analysis is the next step up after ordinary global data analysis. In abolishing the container view of looking at nation states, we in social policy science in particular need to focus on (global) local data, not on national-aggregated, averaged(!)-data. Schumpeter (1951) knew about the problems of science based on (scientifically random, meaningless, fully obscuring) national boundaries and their aggregates. Social policy science needs to follow this imperative.

AI.tldr: 本文批判社会政策研究中描述性与规范性研究的割裂问题，强调需要结合全球多中心案例研究和全球本地数据分析来克服国家边界限制，推动社会政策科学的发展。
AI.research_question: 如何解决社会政策研究中描述性研究与规范性研究之间的割裂问题？如何通过全球多中心案例研究和全球本地数据分析来改进社会政策科学？
AI.motivation: 社会政策研究存在严重问题：描述性研究随意添加规范性建议，规范性研究不了解实证现实，且大多数研究局限于少数西方国家。需要全球多中心案例研究和全球本地数据分析来克服这些局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: Modood和Favell(2003)、Bauböck(2008)关于社会政策理论互动问题的理论框架；Schumpeter(1951)对国家边界科学局限性的批判；Wong和Ho(2023)关于多中心案例研究的应用。
AI.method: 全球多中心案例研究（如Wong和Ho对新冠疫情应对的研究）；全球本地数据分析（超越国家聚合数据的分析）；比较研究方法。
AI.findings: 社会政策研究存在描述性与规范性研究的严重割裂；大多数研究局限于少数西方国家；全球多中心案例研究价值巨大但未得到充分重视；需要超越国家边界的数据分析方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会政策研究中描述性与规范性研究整合的理论框架；强调了超越国家边界分析的重要性；发展了全球本地数据分析的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了全球多中心案例研究的方法论指导；提出了从国家聚合数据转向全球本地数据的实践路径；为社会政策制定者提供了更全面的分析框架。

title: Exploring the Energy-Emissions-Growth Nexus in Papua New Guinea: A Cointegration Analysis using Vector Error Correction Model
affiliations: I-RISC Insights

detail.title: Exploring the Energy-Emissions-Growth Nexus in Papua New Guinea: A Cointegration Analysis using Vector Error Correction Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of Interest with organizations and institutions mentioned in the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No patient or participant was interviewed or engaged for this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this paer.

detail.abstract: The study investigates the equilibrium relationships and dynamic causal interactions among economic growth, energy generation, energy consumption, and carbon emissions in Papua New Guinea, using annual time-series data from 2000 to 2024. The objective is to assess the presence of energy-led growth in GDP, both in the short-run and long-run. The stationarity of the variables was tested using the Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) unit root tests, followed by Johansen's cointegration tests to identify long-term relationships. A Vector Error Correction Model (VECM) was employed to capture short-run dynamics, with Granger causality tests and Impulse Response Functions (IRFs) used to analyze directional influence and temporal responses. The results reveal cointegration among the series, indicating stable long-term relationships. In the short-run, both energy generation and energy consumption granger-cause GDP, suggesting a unidirectional energy-led growth pattern. IRFs show that a unit shock in either energy variable induces modest, fluctuating responses in GDP that dissipate over time, converging toward equilibrium in the long-run. These findings underscore the strategic importance of energy sector development in driving economic growth, while highlighting the need for sustainable energy policies to balance growth objectives with environmental considerations.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2000-2024年数据，通过ADF单位根检验、Johansen协整检验、VECM模型、格兰杰因果检验和脉冲响应函数，分析了巴布亚新几内亚经济增长、能源生产、能源消费和碳排放之间的均衡关系与动态因果互动。
AI.research_question: 巴布亚新几内亚的经济增长、能源生产、能源消费和碳排放之间是否存在长期均衡关系和短期动态因果互动？是否存在能源驱动的经济增长模式？
AI.motivation: 评估巴布亚新几内亚能源部门发展对经济增长的推动作用，同时平衡经济增长目标与环境考虑，为制定可持续能源政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源-经济增长关系理论、环境库兹涅茨曲线、协整理论、向量误差修正模型、格兰杰因果关系理论。
AI.method: 使用2000-2024年年度时间序列数据，进行ADF单位根检验、Johansen协整检验、构建向量误差修正模型(VECM)、格兰杰因果检验和脉冲响应函数分析。
AI.findings: 1. 变量之间存在协整关系，表明长期稳定关系；2. 短期内能源生产和能源消费都格兰杰导致GDP增长，呈现单向能源驱动增长模式；3. 脉冲响应显示能源变量冲击对GDP产生适度波动响应，随时间消散并收敛于长期均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 为能源-经济增长关系理论提供了巴布亚新几内亚的实证证据，验证了能源驱动增长假说，扩展了发展中国家能源经济关系研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了能源部门发展对经济增长的战略重要性，为政策制定者提供了制定可持续能源政策的实证依据，平衡经济增长与环境保护目标。

title: Central Clearing and the Pricing of Specialness in Repo Markets
affiliations: , University of Bristol - Department of Finance and Accounting, ,  and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Central Clearing and the Pricing of Specialness in Repo Markets

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Repo markets clear either bilaterally over the counter (OTC) or through central counterparties (CCPs), which differ in how counterparty risk is priced. In bilateral markets, repo rates reflect borrower-specific risk, while CCP clearing pools counterparties and applies a common pricing rule. We develop a model of security-driven repo in which repo rates are non-linear in borrower risk. As a result, averaging borrower-specific OTC prices yields more negative rates than pricing the pooled borrower in CCP markets. The model predicts that the CCP–OTC specialness gap compresses during periods of counterparty uncertainty and varies with borrower and collateral characteristics. Using transaction-level data from the euro-area interbank repo market around the March 2020 COVID-19 shock, we find evidence consistent with these predictions. Our results show that central clearing dampens specialness in normal times but stabilizes repo pricing during stress.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了双边OTC市场和CCP清算在回购市场中如何不同地定价对手方风险，发现CCP清算在正常时期会抑制特殊利差，但在压力时期能稳定回购定价。
AI.research_question: 中央对手方(CCP)清算与双边场外交易(OTC)在回购市场中如何不同地定价对手方风险？CCP-OTC特殊利差如何随市场条件变化？
AI.motivation: 回购市场通过双边OTC或CCP清算，两者在对手方风险定价方式上存在差异，这种差异对市场稳定性和定价效率有重要影响，特别是在压力时期。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于证券驱动的回购模型，其中回购利率与借款人风险呈非线性关系。模型预测CCP清算通过风险池化产生与双边OTC不同的定价结果。
AI.method: 开发理论模型分析回购利率定价机制，然后使用欧元区银行间回购市场在2020年3月COVID-19冲击期间的交易级数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 1) 平均借款人特定的OTC价格比CCP市场中的池化借款人定价产生更负的利率；2) CCP-OTC特殊利差在对手方不确定性期间压缩；3) 特殊利差随借款人和抵押品特征变化；4) CCP清算在正常时期抑制特殊利差，但在压力时期稳定回购定价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了证券驱动的回购模型，解释了回购利率与借款人风险的非线性关系；2) 理论预测了CCP与OTC定价差异的动态变化机制；3) 阐明了中央清算在不同市场条件下的稳定作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构设计清算机制提供理论依据；2) 帮助市场参与者理解不同清算方式下的风险定价差异；3) 为压力时期的流动性管理提供指导；4) 对回购市场基础设施设计有重要政策含义。

title: Crime Scene Investigation Method in Social Policy Analysis

detail.title: Crime Scene Investigation Method in Social Policy Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper explains the crime scene investigation method in social policy analysis. Social policy as a science has a been subject to a great number of expanding realms of applications. Social policy as a science in the past has been constantly addressing—and needs to address—new problems, new aspects of human lives/governance/societies, and entire new fields of sciences that ask for solutions, for social policy solutions (from recent Covid-19 pandemic responses, health outcomes, and losses of human dignity, to ongoing climate change and its impact on human lives and human civilizations, and artificial intelligence making human work redundant and hence obsolete, and so forth). Topics and tasks at hand, or in front of us, on the road ahead (be it tomorrow, in two years from now, or decades and centuries down the road) have pushed, and are pushing, social policy to reveal its limits.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种"犯罪现场调查"方法用于社会政策分析，旨在应对社会政策科学在应对新兴挑战（如新冠疫情、气候变化、人工智能等）时面临的局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种有效的方法来分析和解决社会政策科学在应对新兴复杂社会问题时的局限性？
AI.motivation: 社会政策科学面临不断扩大的应用领域和新兴挑战（如新冠疫情、气候变化、人工智能等），这些挑战暴露了现有社会政策方法的局限性，需要新的分析方法来应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪现场调查方法在社会政策分析中的应用框架，借鉴法医学的系统调查逻辑来分析社会政策问题。
AI.method: 犯罪现场调查方法，包括证据收集、现场分析、线索追踪等法医学技术在社会政策分析中的适应性应用。
AI.findings: 犯罪现场调查方法为社会政策分析提供了系统化的分析框架，能够更有效地识别社会问题的根源、影响因素和解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法医学的调查方法引入社会政策分析领域，拓展了跨学科研究方法论，为社会政策科学提供了新的分析工具和理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种系统化的分析工具，帮助更有效地识别和解决复杂社会问题，提高政策干预的精准性和有效性。

title: Spectral Data Analysis

detail.title: Spectral Data Analysis
detail.abstract: The development of discipline-specific methodology has been a forgotten child of social policy science. Yet, naturally social policy scientists focus a great deal on the power of case study analyses (Yin, 1994a,b), and mixed methods (Brannen, 1992, 2005, 2021). Some methods are overused, while others are underused, not used, and quite often simply not pointed out-the usage of methods is often automatically practiced, without developing the theory of methodology, and without pointing to the specific methods used, how they work, and/or their difference to other methods. In 2023, Aspalter, pointed out, explained and emphasized the understanding, rationale and usage of the spectral data analysis, comparing and differentiating it from other disciplines' usages, like famously in physics and chemistry, as well as economics. In physics, we look at e.g. black holes (and try to find white holes, and grey holes) when looking at the stars, with the right equipment of course. In chemistry, we look at tiniest (so it seems) things, also with the right equipment of course. While normal pictures are out of the question, scientists in both cases use a special technique, i.e. in physics they look at any kind of emissions, their distortions/diversions, and so forth; in chemistry e.g. they also look at emissions e.g. after radiating the object under investigation. As welfare state systems, in social policy science, do not produce, reflect or bend light, radio or gamma waves, or emit/reflect radiation, things are different. The flow of work steps is different, and the location and the nature of the object under scrutiny also differ entirely. In general, in the social sciences, the method of spectral data analysis can be defined as: "the determination of the constitution, conditions and/or functioning … of the research objects … by means of determining and analyzing spectra of distinct outcomes and patterns of outcomes they produce." (Aspalter, 2023a: 28)

AI.tldr: 该论文指出社会政策科学中学科特定方法论发展不足，提出并解释了光谱数据分析方法在社会政策科学中的应用，区别于物理学、化学等其他学科的使用方式。
AI.research_question: 社会政策科学如何发展和应用学科特定的方法论，特别是光谱数据分析方法？
AI.motivation: 社会政策科学中学科特定方法论发展被忽视，研究方法使用存在过度使用、使用不足或未明确说明的问题，需要发展理论化的方法论体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 案例研究分析（Yin）、混合方法（Brannen）、光谱数据分析理论（Aspalter）。
AI.method: 光谱数据分析方法，定义为"通过确定和分析研究对象产生的不同结果和结果模式的光谱，来确定其构成、条件和/或功能"。
AI.findings: 社会政策科学中的光谱数据分析与物理学、化学中的应用不同，福利国家系统不产生、反射或弯曲光波、无线电波或伽马波，也不发射/反射辐射，因此工作流程、研究对象的位置和性质完全不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会政策科学中光谱数据分析的理论框架，明确了其在社会科学中的具体定义和应用方式，区别于自然科学中的使用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会政策科学家提供了具体的方法论工具，帮助他们更系统、理论化地使用光谱数据分析方法，避免方法的自动实践和未明确说明的问题。

title: Container Science, Container Social Policy

detail.title: Container Science, Container Social Policy
detail.abstract: This article introduces the problem of container science, and hence also container social policy. The term container sociology, and the subsequent terms of container science, container economics, binary container gender studies, and so forth, all have their roots in the works of German sociologist Ulrich Beck (2006, 2007, 2009, 2016; as well as Beck and Sznaider, 2006). Beck particularly fleshed out the idea of container sociology, where the compartmentalization into nation states that resemble arbitrary containers that determine what we look at and what we see and measure in science, be it in sociology or economics, or other sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了"容器科学"问题及其在社会政策中的应用，这一概念源于德国社会学家乌尔里希·贝克的理论，强调民族国家作为容器的区隔作用如何影响社会科学研究视角。
AI.research_question: 容器科学如何影响社会科学研究视角？民族国家作为"容器"的区隔作用如何塑造社会学、经济学等学科的研究范式？
AI.motivation: 传统社会科学研究往往受限于民族国家的边界框架，这种"容器化"视角限制了我们对全球化背景下社会现象的理解，需要重新审视学科研究的基本假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乌尔里希·贝克的容器社会学理论，强调民族国家作为社会分析的基本单位如何塑造研究视角；容器科学、容器经济学、二元容器性别研究等相关概念框架。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论建构，基于贝克及其合作者的著作进行理论梳理和概念发展，采用文献分析和理论反思的方法。
AI.findings: 社会科学研究长期受民族国家"容器"框架的限制，这种区隔影响了研究问题的选择、测量方法和理论建构；需要超越容器视角来应对全球化挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了容器科学的概念谱系，发展了容器社会政策的理论框架，为批判性反思社会科学研究的基本单位提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供超越民族国家框架的分析工具，帮助识别跨边界的社会问题，促进更加全球化的社会政策设计。

reference: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 574; 75 Emory L.J. Online 32 (2026)
title: Government Goes Goop
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: Government Goes Goop

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I also have no conflict of interests to report.
declarations.funderStatement: I have not received any funding support for this research beyond my normal salary as a law professor.

keywords: Department of Health and Human Services

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 574
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This Article argues that the appointment of prominent wellness and antivaccine figures to senior federal health positions marks the culmination of a long-running evolution in American health fraud—from nineteenth-century traveling medicine shows to the institutional capture of government health agencies. Drawing a direct lineage from patent medicine marketing to contemporary wellness conspiracism, this Article demonstrates how tactics perfected by early medicine show entrepreneurs—emotional manipulation, conspiratorial framing, anti-establishment positioning, and the exploitation of information asymmetries—have persisted across regulatory and technological shifts, ultimately achieving unprecedented political legitimacy.

 This Article traces this evolution through the deregulated supplement marketplace created by the Dietary Supplement Health and Education Act of 1994, the amplification of health misinformation by social media platforms, and the COVID-19 pandemic’s destabilization of public trust in scientific authority. It then examines how these dynamics enabled the elevation of wellness-aligned figures to leadership roles at the Department of Health and Human Services, the National Institutes of Health, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and the Food and Drug Administration. The resulting transformation of federal health agencies—from evidence-based institutions into platforms for wellness ideology—has produced immediate public health consequences, including mass resignations of career officials, preventable disease outbreaks, and erosion of America’s scientific credibility.

 By situating contemporary wellness governance within a longer history of health fraud and regulatory arbitrage, this Article contends that the phenomenon of “government gone Goop” represents a broader crisis of democratic governance: whether institutions tasked with protecting the public can maintain epistemic integrity in information environments that reward confusion, distrust, and commercially profitable misinformation.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯美国健康欺诈从19世纪巡回医药秀到现代政府卫生机构被"健康养生"反疫苗人士渗透的演变历程，分析这一现象如何威胁公共卫生和民主治理。
AI.research_question: 美国健康欺诈如何从19世纪的巡回医药秀演变为当代政府卫生机构被"健康养生"意识形态渗透的现象？
AI.motivation: 揭示健康欺诈策略如何跨越监管和技术变革持续存在，并最终获得政治合法性，威胁公共卫生机构和民主治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康欺诈演变理论、监管套利理论、信息不对称理论、机构俘获理论、民主治理危机理论。
AI.method: 历史分析法和案例研究法，追溯从19世纪至今的健康欺诈演变，分析《膳食补充剂健康与教育法案》、社交媒体、COVID-19疫情等关键节点。
AI.findings: 健康欺诈策略（情感操纵、阴谋论框架、反建制定位、信息不对称利用）在监管和技术变革中持续存在；"健康养生"人士已渗透到HHS、NIH、CMS、FDA等联邦卫生机构；导致职业官员大规模辞职、可预防疾病爆发、美国科学信誉受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了健康欺诈从商业欺诈到政治合法化的演变框架；提出了"政府Goop化"概念，连接健康欺诈与民主治理危机；发展了监管套利在信息时代的新应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示公共卫生机构被意识形态渗透的风险；为监管改革提供历史依据；帮助识别和应对健康欺诈的政治化趋势；为维护科学证据在公共卫生决策中的核心地位提供策略。

title: Engineering the Pursuit of Happiness: How Social Policy Can Influence Behavior to Reduce Mortality Rates Due to Non-Communicable Diseases (or Modern Mass Diseases)

detail.title: Engineering the Pursuit of Happiness: How Social Policy Can Influence Behavior to Reduce Mortality Rates Due to Non-Communicable Diseases (or Modern Mass Diseases)
detail.abstract: This paper shortly addresses the potentials of Developmental Social Policy when applying it to the realm of health policy, and the apparent need for doing so. Developmental Social Policy is a normative (prescriptive) social policy theory that offers strategies and policy solutions to prevent and reduce any social problems, also health care problems, such as the high rates of mortality and sufferings caused by prominent modern mass diseases (or non-communicable diseases, NCDs) of our time. This study gives detailed, practical and realistic policy suggestions, based on a preventative health policy strategy, as is laid out by and supported by the theory of Developmental Social Policy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了发展型社会政策在健康政策领域的应用潜力及其必要性，提出了基于预防性健康策略的具体政策建议。
AI.research_question: 发展型社会政策如何应用于健康政策领域？其应用的必要性是什么？
AI.motivation: 现代社会中非传染性疾病(NCDs)导致的高死亡率和痛苦需要有效的预防性政策干预，而发展型社会政策为此提供了理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 发展型社会政策理论——一种规范性的社会政策理论，旨在预防和减少社会问题（包括健康问题）。
AI.method: 理论分析与政策建议制定，基于发展型社会政策的理论框架提出预防性健康政策策略。
AI.findings: 发展型社会政策在健康政策领域具有重要应用潜力，能够为预防现代大规模疾病（非传染性疾病）提供有效的政策解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将发展型社会政策理论扩展到健康政策领域，展示了该理论在解决现代健康问题中的适用性和价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了详细、实用且现实的预防性健康政策建议，为政策制定者应对非传染性疾病问题提供了具体策略。

title: Social Contracts as Power Relations

detail.title: Social Contracts as Power Relations
detail.abstract: To interpret history is nothing else than to reinterpret it, in one's own ways, where however one's own ways are never what they seem, one's own ways. Our thoughts are the music that one hears for oneself, but the instruments have been constructed, arranged and conducted, and played again and again, in the past by the whole of humanity, to be precise, the ones that control humanity and their vassals. Our actions, our measures, our senses, arguments and rationalizations are never new, they rose from the past, there are controlled from the past (Nietzsche, 1878, 1887), far distant past and the immediate past. In addition, the future also controls the present, by way of expectations and evaluations of future events and developments (especially expectations of repercussions or rewards of any kind). Social contracts are attempts to interpret/reinterpret our past, our human past, of civilization and modernization, in order to legitimize power today, and down the road into the future. Power relations are what made us think about, and in the following propagate, social contracts, or the one or other particular form/idea of a social contract of this or that nature.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨历史解释的本质，认为历史解释本质上是基于权力关系的重新解释，我们的思想、行动和理性都受到过去和未来的控制，社会契约是对人类文明历史的重新解释以合法化当前和未来的权力关系。
AI.research_question: 历史解释的本质是什么？社会契约如何作为历史重新解释的工具来合法化权力关系？
AI.motivation: 探讨历史解释与社会权力结构之间的关系，揭示历史解释如何被用于合法化当前和未来的权力关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尼采的历史哲学（1878, 1887），权力关系理论，社会契约理论，历史解释学。
AI.method: 哲学思辨与理论分析，基于尼采哲学和社会契约理论的批判性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 历史解释本质上是重新解释；2. 我们的思想和行动都受到过去和未来的控制；3. 社会契约是对人类历史的重新解释以合法化权力；4. 权力关系塑造了我们对社会契约的思考和传播。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了基于权力关系的历史解释理论；2. 将社会契约理论重新定位为历史解释的工具；3. 整合了尼采哲学与社会契约理论的批判视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解历史解释的政治功能；2. 揭示社会契约作为权力合法化机制的本质；3. 为批判性历史分析提供理论工具。

reference: Forthcoming: in C. Aspalter (ed.), Elgar Research Encyclopedia of Social Policy. Cheltenham: Edward Elgar
title: Preventative Social Policy

detail.title: Preventative Social Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming: in C. Aspalter (ed.), Elgar Research Encyclopedia of Social Policy. Cheltenham: Edward Elgar

detail.abstract: The best accident is the one that never happened. The best health care and best long-term care is the one that is not needed, because prevention prevented it. In social policy today, preventative approaches and goals are rare, and if mostly resort to lip service and lofty ideas, without concrete (actual) measures and consequences, without professional top priority given, without systemic applications, and without systematic, comprehensive and constant implementation. Prevention is feasible and the future of social policy depends on preventative social policy to take the lead, i.e. not to replace curative social policy, but to build the first track of social policy, besides curative social policy. Most modern mass diseases, as we know (should know) today, are preventable the very most part for the very most people (at least strongly delayable and reduceable). We have all sorts of workable (financeable, operable, and politically fully realistic) options to successfully, comprehensively, fully effectively and efficiently, and most important in a fully humane and decent manner, conduct preventative social policy. The political will will be there, once if the social policy awareness, practice and goals have been established and disseminated, accepted and wholeheartedly and continuously applied. Up to 90 percent (and more) of a great deal of modern mass diseases, the silent pandemics, are preventable if people start prevent them early in their lives and comprehensively, accumulating good healthy foods, drinks, exercise, happiness, sleep, social support, and buy preventing (avoiding) negative unhealthy foods and sugary/alcoholic drinks (including tobacco consumption), sedentary lifestyles, overweight, unhappiness, loneliness, social/cultural/economic/financial exclusion, etc. Hence, preventative health policy must become the mainstay of preventative social policy.

AI.tldr: 本文主张预防性社会政策应成为社会政策的首要轨道，强调通过早期、全面的预防措施可避免90%以上的现代大众疾病，需要系统性实施而非停留在口号层面。
AI.research_question: 如何建立和实施有效的预防性社会政策作为社会政策的首要轨道，以预防现代大众疾病并减少社会问题？
AI.motivation: 当前社会政策中预防性方法往往停留在口号层面，缺乏具体措施、专业优先权、系统性应用和持续实施，而现代大众疾病大部分是可预防的，需要建立真正的预防性社会政策体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防性社会政策理论、公共卫生预防理论、社会决定健康理论、系统性政策实施框架
AI.method: 概念性分析、政策文献综述、预防措施可行性论证、基于现有科学证据的预防策略构建
AI.findings: 预防性社会政策在财务、操作和政治上都是可行的；90%以上的现代大众疾病可通过早期全面预防避免；预防性健康政策应成为预防性社会政策的核心；政治意愿会在预防意识、实践和目标建立后自然形成。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了预防性社会政策作为社会政策首要轨道的理论框架；建立了预防性社会政策与预防性健康政策的理论联系；发展了系统性预防政策实施的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实施预防性社会政策的具体路径；提出了可操作的预防措施组合（健康饮食、运动、社会支持等）；展示了预防性政策在财务和政治上的可行性；为减少医疗和社会服务需求提供了实践方案。

title: Preventative Long-Term Care Policy

detail.title: Preventative Long-Term Care Policy
detail.abstract: Long-term care needs are not the outcome of aging, not per se, even though aging plays a role in the quantitative and qualitative determination of long-term care needs. When one e.g. goes up a mountain in Austria or Switzerland, one can find many people that are around 60 years old that drive their (non-electric) mountain bike up steep and real (high) mountains, alone, or couples. The saying that the 60s are the new 40s, then, really makes sense.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨长期护理需求与年龄的关系，指出年龄增长并非长期护理需求的直接原因，而是通过影响身体机能间接起作用。作者通过观察60多岁人群在山区骑行的例子，说明现代老年人保持良好身体机能的可能性。
AI.research_question: 年龄增长是否直接导致长期护理需求？如果不是，那么长期护理需求形成的真正机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为年龄增长必然导致长期护理需求，但作者观察到许多60多岁人群仍保持良好身体机能，能够进行高强度活动，这挑战了年龄与护理需求的简单线性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康老龄化理论、功能能力理论、长期护理需求决定因素理论
AI.method: 观察性研究、案例分析方法，通过实地观察奥地利和瑞士山区60多岁人群的骑行活动进行分析
AI.findings: 年龄增长本身并不直接导致长期护理需求，而是通过影响身体机能间接起作用。许多60多岁人群仍保持良好身体机能，能够进行高强度活动，"60岁是新的40岁"的说法具有现实依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了年龄与长期护理需求的简单线性关系，提出了年龄通过身体机能中介影响护理需求的理论框架，为健康老龄化研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为长期护理政策制定提供新思路，强调促进健康老龄化的重要性，为老年人健康干预措施提供理论支持，有助于更精准地预测和规划长期护理需求。

title: Preventative Health Policy

detail.title: Preventative Health Policy
detail.abstract: Nobody is really interested in it. Yet it would make only sense to see it as the number 1 solution to health care problems. To tell people to drink curcuma milk adding a bit of pepper in it is not a business potential, as these are being relatively or very cheap items. Cancer, diabetes on the other hand are great for business greed, and government officials' post-public job market opportunities (payoff opportunities as consultants, lobbyists, and especially board members).

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性地分析了医疗保健系统中利益冲突问题，指出真正有效的健康解决方案（如姜黄牛奶）因缺乏商业利益而被忽视，而癌症、糖尿病等疾病则因商业利益和政治腐败而被过度关注。
AI.research_question: 医疗保健系统中商业利益和政治腐败如何影响健康解决方案的选择和推广？
AI.motivation: 当前医疗保健系统忽视简单有效的健康解决方案（如姜黄牛奶），而过度关注能带来巨大商业利益的疾病（如癌症、糖尿病），这反映了医疗保健领域的利益冲突和腐败问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益冲突理论、医疗保健政治经济学、监管俘获理论、商业利益驱动医疗决策理论
AI.method: 批判性分析、案例研究（姜黄牛奶与癌症/糖尿病治疗的对比）、利益相关者分析、制度分析
AI.findings: 1. 简单有效的健康解决方案因缺乏商业潜力而被忽视；2. 癌症、糖尿病等疾病因能为制药公司、医疗机构和政府官员带来巨大利益而被过度关注；3. 存在政府官员与医疗产业之间的旋转门现象（退休后担任顾问、游说者、董事会成员）；4. 医疗保健决策受到商业利益而非公共卫生需求的驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了医疗保健政治经济学理论，揭示了商业利益如何扭曲健康解决方案的选择；2. 发展了监管俘获理论在医疗保健领域的应用；3. 提出了"利益冲突医疗决策模型"；4. 丰富了医疗腐败研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改革医疗保健系统的建议；2. 帮助公众识别医疗保健中的利益冲突；3. 为医疗监管机构提供监督框架；4. 促进基于证据而非商业利益的健康解决方案推广。

title: Thematic Meta Analysis in Social Policy Science

detail.title: Thematic Meta Analysis in Social Policy Science
detail.abstract: Each scientific discipline has to build and develop further discipline-specific methodology; i.e. to focus on, use and develop unique sets of methods that are designed to, or simply happen to, bring about progress in knowledge creation and deepening, as well as critical evaluations thereof. Social policy science is dealing with all sorts of problems that are mostly shared by countries, societies, communities all over the world, with at times great differences, and sometimes not. Social policy is also home to multi-layered, Lasagna-style social problems or societal problems, and scientific problems (in general) as well. Wicked causalities, wicked interactions, wicked hidden truths and hidden pasts, hidden side effects, hidden follow-on effects, all contribute to the need to upgrade analytical methodology. The word 'meta', in meta analysis, comes from Greek language and stands mostly for 'beyond,' i.e. beyond the usual, beyond the normal. Some studies are conceptualized at greater level-some abstract level, some global level, some grand-ourstorical(grand-historical) level, some try to tackle multilayered/multicyclical causalities, some are just so wide that they cover many more topics and themes in themselves, by themselves. These are all meta studies, using the method of (non-statistical) meta analysis, which here is understood as a social-policyscience-specific method (Aspalter, 2021). This has nothing to do with marketing, psychology, or medical science, etc., where different kinds of statistical meta analyses are applied, focusing on merging data and findings of other (a great, greater number of) studies. To be sure in social policy science, non-statistical meta analyses are very common, and super influential in bringing about progress, exploration, understanding and solutions (Aspalter, 2021). Grand themes, i.e. meta thematic analyses, are actually the main or most frequent choice of a great deal of social policy scientists.

AI.tldr: 本文提出社会政策科学需要发展特定的元分析方法论，以应对复杂的社会问题，强调非统计性元分析在该领域的重要性。
AI.research_question: 社会政策科学如何发展和应用特定的元分析方法论来应对复杂的多层社会问题？
AI.motivation: 社会政策科学面临复杂的多层社会问题，需要超越常规的分析方法来处理隐藏的因果关系、副作用和后续效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会政策科学的元分析方法论框架，强调非统计性元分析在理解复杂社会问题中的作用。
AI.method: 非统计性元分析方法，包括元主题分析、多层/多周期因果分析、宏观历史分析等。
AI.findings: 非统计性元分析在社会政策科学中非常普遍且具有重要影响力，是推动该领域知识进步的关键方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会政策科学特有的元分析方法论，区别于其他学科（如心理学、医学）的统计性元分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会政策研究者提供了处理复杂社会问题的分析工具，促进对全球性社会问题的深入理解和解决方案开发。

title: Evolutionary Social Policy Theory: Its 8 Axioms, 6 Theorems

detail.title: Evolutionary Social Policy Theory: Its 8 Axioms, 6 Theorems
detail.abstract: For social policy science, we do not have such a marked tradition, as well as deep-and far-reaching theory. Yet, free after Thorstein Veblen (1898), we can throw up the following thought into the air: why is social policy science not an evolutionary science? For one, the recipients of social policy actions, protection, money and institutions, are recipients and not the prime actors per se. Social policy is the action of governments, who may or may not act upon the actions of people (protests, voting behaviors, survey, changing needs and demands, etc.). Thus, things are more complicated, but yet doable, when pointing the spotlight onto the politicians, administrators and experts themselves (see below). Historical analyses and historical case studies are always to greater or smaller degree evolutionary, upholding per definition (of what history does) a dynamic point of view, where time and history matters.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨社会政策科学为何不是一门进化科学，认为社会政策的接受者不是主要行动者，而政府行动与人民行动之间的关系更为复杂，但通过聚焦政治家、行政人员和专家，结合历史分析，可以实现进化视角。
AI.research_question: 为什么社会政策科学不是一门进化科学？
AI.motivation: 社会政策科学缺乏深厚的理论传统，需要借鉴Thorstein Veblen的思想，探索社会政策作为进化科学的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Thorstein Veblen的进化经济学思想；社会政策接受者与行动者关系的理论；历史进化视角。
AI.method: 历史分析和历史案例研究，采用动态时间视角，聚焦政治家、行政人员和专家的行动。
AI.findings: 社会政策科学可以通过聚焦政策制定者和执行者（政治家、行政人员、专家），结合历史进化分析，成为一门进化科学。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社会政策科学引入进化科学视角，建立社会政策作为进化科学的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供进化视角来理解和设计社会政策，强调历史动态和时间因素的重要性。

reference: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series No. 247
title: Democratic Sovereignty and the Prerogative to Make Money: The Case of the Federal Reserve
affiliations: Harvard Law School

detail.title: Democratic Sovereignty and the Prerogative to Make Money: The Case of the Federal Reserve

publicationDetails.detailsText: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series No. 247
publicationDetails.journalName: Institute for New Economic Thinking Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The surge of executive power unleashed by the Supreme Court has reached the Federal Reserve, provoking a crisis that the justices seem suddenly anxious to avoid. But the drama is long overdue. The central bank has a constitutional stature that poses a direct challenge to unitary executive theory, the principle animating the Court's recent case law. Congress established the Federal Reserve System to carry out a critical legislative prerogative-making the sovereign money supply. Congress used an institutional form-national banking-innovated precisely to secure sovereign money-making from executive (originally monarchical) interference. Congress in turn assigned a vital responsibility-the capacity to make money out of debt in the people's name-to the Fed. The constitutional conclusion follows: Congress's prerogative over money-making clearly secures the Fed's independence from presidential interference. That conclusion is lost in current scholarship that treats the Fed as fundamentally like other independent agencies. The Court has assumed, similarly, that the unitary executive presides over a relatively homogeneous regulatory field.  The case of the Fed exposes the separation of powers as a more complicated project.  Legislatures built democratic sovereignty by struggling for prerogatives that, like money-making, protected their lawmaking authority.  The prerogatives claimed by Congress inform the work of each agency and official, including within the executive branch.  The Court dismantles democratic sovereignty when it denies the reach of those prerogatives.

AI.tldr: 最高法院的权力扩张已波及美联储，引发宪法危机。论文主张美联储的货币创造权是国会立法特权，应独立于总统行政权，挑战了当前"单一行政理论"的司法假设。
AI.research_question: 美联储的宪法地位如何挑战最高法院的单一行政理论？国会对货币创造的立法特权如何保障美联储独立于总统行政干预？
AI.motivation: 最高法院权力扩张已影响美联储，引发宪法危机。当前学界和司法实践错误地将美联储视为普通独立机构，忽视了其独特的宪法地位和国会货币创造特权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单一行政理论、分权制衡理论、民主主权理论、国会立法特权理论。论文挑战了最高法院近期判例所依据的单一行政理论假设。
AI.method: 宪法文本分析、历史制度分析、比较制度分析（对比美联储与其他独立机构）、司法判例分析。
AI.findings: 1. 美联储的货币创造权是国会立法特权，而非行政权；2. 国家银行制度设计初衷就是防止行政（君主）干预；3. 当前司法实践错误地将监管领域视为同质化；4. 分权制衡比单一行政理论更复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战最高法院的单一行政理论；2. 提出"国会立法特权"理论框架；3. 重新界定美联储的宪法地位；4. 揭示分权制衡的复杂性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为美联储独立性提供宪法依据；2. 警示最高法院权力扩张的危险；3. 为国会维护立法特权提供理论支持；4. 促进对民主主权的保护。

title: Evaluating Health Care Systems

detail.title: Evaluating Health Care Systems
detail.abstract: This article analyses the field of health care system evaluation. It is not so easy to determine, at first sight and first attempt, what health care systems really are, to the point that is. It are all efforts, services and actions of doctors and nurses (and their respective administrators), be it in a hospital setting, hospice setting, at home or at a community center, or online. Digital programs and platforms, and of course increasingly important also AI (artificial intelligence) applications, machines and robots, are also quickly becoming mainstay operators of service delivery systems, including diagnosis, advice and health education. Pharmaceutical products, technical medical instruments; online applications; oneon-one communications; database creation and usage (harvesting and mining operations); knowledge creation, spread and applications; behavior analysis and guidance (through knowledge sharing in a humane, caring, careful, fully respectful manner), and of course health care personnel training and development are all part of the main imperatives of any health care systems.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了医疗保健系统评估领域，探讨了医疗保健系统的复杂构成，包括传统医疗服务、数字技术、AI应用、药品器械、数据管理、知识传播和人员培训等多个维度。
AI.research_question: 医疗保健系统究竟是什么？如何全面评估医疗保健系统的构成和运作？
AI.motivation: 医疗保健系统的定义和评估存在复杂性，传统视角难以全面涵盖现代医疗保健系统的多元构成要素，需要更全面的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统理论、医疗保健服务评估理论、数字医疗转型理论、人本医疗理论
AI.method: 概念分析、文献综述、系统分析
AI.findings: 医疗保健系统包括：1）传统医疗服务（医院、临终关怀、家庭护理等）；2）数字平台和AI应用；3）药品和医疗器械；4）数据管理和分析；5）知识创造与传播；6）行为分析与指导；7）人员培训与发展。这些要素共同构成现代医疗保健系统的完整生态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了更全面的医疗保健系统定义框架，整合了传统医疗服务与现代数字技术要素，为医疗保健系统评估提供了更完整的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗保健政策制定者、管理者和评估者提供了更全面的系统评估工具，有助于识别系统短板，优化资源配置，推动医疗保健系统数字化转型。

title: Unique Approaches to the Welfare State: Singapore and Hong Kong (Des Modeles Singuliers d'Etat Providence: Singapour et Hong Kong)

detail.title: Unique Approaches to the Welfare State: Singapore and Hong Kong (Des Modeles Singuliers d'Etat Providence: Singapour et Hong Kong)
detail.abstract: This paper looks at welfare state systems in two city states, Singapore and Hong Kong. It traces the causes of welfare state development by investigating the history and politics of social welfare policy, and looks at social welfare institutions from a real-typical perspective, focusing on differences in system design and structure.

AI.tldr: 本文比较新加坡和香港两个城市国家的福利制度，从历史政治角度追溯福利国家发展原因，采用现实类型学视角分析社会福利制度的设计与结构差异。
AI.research_question: 新加坡和香港两个城市国家的福利制度发展原因是什么？它们的福利制度在设计和结构上有何差异？
AI.motivation: 城市国家作为特殊政治实体，其福利制度发展路径与大型民族国家不同，新加坡和香港作为亚洲两个重要的城市国家，其福利制度比较研究具有理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利国家理论、现实类型学（real-typical perspective）、制度比较分析、历史制度主义
AI.method: 历史分析、政治分析、制度比较研究、案例研究（新加坡和香港）
AI.findings: 新加坡和香港的福利制度在设计和结构上存在显著差异，这些差异源于各自的历史发展路径、政治体制和社会经济背景。
AI.theory_contributions: 为城市国家福利制度研究提供理论框架，拓展福利国家理论的适用范围，丰富现实类型学在福利制度比较中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他城市国家或小型经济体的福利政策制定提供参考，帮助政策制定者理解不同制度设计的优劣。

title: Mathematical Social Policy

detail.title: Mathematical Social Policy
detail.abstract: Far from being a travel note from the future, this article points to forgotten and missed out chances of the past. Mathematical psychology, mathematical sociology, and mathematical political science have already made their presence not only felt, but crucial for overall science development in these fields. Social policy as a science and academic discipline has yet to catch up to this development. This article provides a definition and description of mathematical social policy, focusing on new links to and methods from (and with) mathematics.

AI.tldr: 本文指出社会科学中数学方法的重要性，强调数学心理学、数学社会学和数学政治学已取得关键发展，而社会政策科学尚未跟上这一趋势。文章定义了数学社会政策的概念，并探讨了与数学的新联系和方法。
AI.research_question: 社会政策作为一门科学和学术学科如何发展数学方法？数学社会政策应如何定义和实施？
AI.motivation: 数学心理学、数学社会学和数学政治学已经在各自领域取得了关键性发展，而社会政策科学尚未跟上这一数学化趋势，错失了发展机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数学社会科学理论框架，包括数学心理学、数学社会学和数学政治学的理论基础，以及数学方法在社会科学中的应用。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论构建方法，通过定义和描述数学社会政策的概念，探讨数学与社会政策的新联系和方法。
AI.findings: 社会政策科学在数学化方面落后于其他社会科学领域，需要建立数学社会政策这一新领域，发展数学方法在社会政策中的应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数学社会政策的概念框架，为社会政策科学提供了数学化的理论基础，填补了社会政策与数学方法结合的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会政策研究和实践提供了数学方法的指导，有助于提高社会政策制定的科学性和精确性，促进社会政策领域的现代化发展。

title: Healthy Aging, Healthy Living

detail.title: Healthy Aging, Healthy Living

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Social policy in the 21st century is marked and will be charged by its ability to tackle the twin problem of heatlhy aging and healthy living. This article gives a clear introduction into this subject matter.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了21世纪社会政策在应对健康老龄化和健康生活双重挑战方面的作用和重要性。
AI.research_question: 21世纪社会政策如何有效应对健康老龄化和健康生活的双重挑战？
AI.motivation: 21世纪社会面临人口老龄化和生活方式变化带来的健康挑战，社会政策需要适应这些变化以促进全民健康。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会政策理论、健康老龄化理论、公共卫生政策框架
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析
AI.findings: 社会政策在促进健康老龄化和健康生活方面具有关键作用，需要综合性的政策设计来应对双重挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了社会政策与健康老龄化理论，提出了应对双重健康挑战的政策框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会政策制定者提供了应对健康老龄化和健康生活挑战的指导原则和政策方向。

title: Extended Case Study Method: A Forgotten Child in Social Science Methodology

detail.title: Extended Case Study Method: A Forgotten Child in Social Science Methodology
detail.abstract: This article focuses on the development of the theory of methodology in social policy science, taking on and explaining the for the most part neglected method of extended case study analyses; its advantages and rich outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦于社会政策科学中方法论理论的发展，重点探讨了被忽视的扩展案例研究方法，分析了其优势和丰富成果。
AI.research_question: 社会政策科学中扩展案例研究方法的价值和优势是什么？如何通过该方法丰富社会政策研究的方法论体系？
AI.motivation: 社会政策科学中方法论理论发展不足，特别是扩展案例研究方法被忽视，需要系统阐述其价值和潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会政策科学方法论理论、案例研究方法论、扩展案例研究理论
AI.method: 理论分析、方法论探讨、扩展案例研究的优势分析
AI.findings: 扩展案例研究方法具有独特优势，能够产生丰富的研究成果，对社会政策科学方法论发展有重要价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社会政策科学的方法论理论体系，为扩展案例研究提供了理论支持，填补了方法论研究的空白。
