AI.tldr: 本文通过建立四玩家博弈模型解释全球饥饿问题，提出通过将慢性营养不良纳入主权信用风险评估来改变博弈均衡，从而减少饥饿。
AI.research_question: 为什么在全球热量过剩的情况下仍有7.33亿人长期营养不良？如何通过机制设计改变这一均衡？
AI.motivation: 全球存在热量过剩与大规模饥饿并存的现象，现有国际制度未能有效解决这一矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（纳什均衡、机制设计）、主权信用风险评估理论、粮食贸易寡头垄断理论
AI.method: 建立四玩家两阶段博弈模型，参数化收益函数，推导均衡条件，应用机制设计逻辑修改收益结构
AI.findings: 饥饿现状是纳什均衡；通过将慢性营养不良纳入主权信用风险评估可以改变均衡，使减少饥饿成为各玩家的最优策略
AI.theory_contributions: 提出全球饥饿博弈模型，建立β-充分性条件，展示如何通过单一价格信号改变多玩家博弈均衡
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可操作的政策干预方案：将营养不良风险纳入主权信用评级，通过市场机制自动执行

title: The Effects of Political Risk on Exchange Rates: Evidence from Korea
affiliations: Bank of Korea and Bank of Korea

detail.title: The Effects of Political Risk on Exchange Rates: Evidence from Korea
detail.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of political risk on exchange rates by exploiting Korea's unexpected martial law declaration of December 3, 2024 as a natural experiment. We decompose bilateral exchange rates for 37 countries into a global dollar factor and a countryspecific residual using a dynamic factor model, then apply an event-study difference-indifferences regression with Korea as the treated unit. We find that the political shock caused KRW to depreciate by 2.29 percentage points in December 2024, accounting for approximately 72% of the total monthly KRW depreciation. The effect persisted through early 2025 and began to recede only after the Constitutional Court's unanimous ruling in April 2025 resolved the political uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 利用韩国2024年12月3日意外戒严令作为自然实验，研究发现政治风险导致韩元在当月贬值2.29个百分点，占当月总贬值的72%，效应持续到2025年初，直到宪法法院裁决后才消退。
AI.research_question: 政治风险对汇率有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 政治风险对汇率影响的理论机制存在争议，需要实证证据；韩国意外戒严令提供了难得的自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治风险与汇率关系理论；自然实验方法；动态因子模型；事件研究双重差分法。
AI.method: 利用韩国2024年12月3日意外戒严令作为自然实验，采用动态因子模型分解37国双边汇率为全球美元因子和国家特定残差，然后以韩国为处理组进行事件研究双重差分回归。
AI.findings: 政治冲击导致韩元在2024年12月贬值2.29个百分点，占当月总贬值的72%；效应持续到2025年初，直到2025年4月宪法法院一致裁决解决政治不确定性后才开始消退。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了政治风险对汇率因果影响的实证证据；验证了政治不确定性对货币价值的负面效应；展示了自然实验在金融研究中的应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供政治风险对汇率影响的具体量化证据；为投资者评估政治事件对货币市场的影响提供参考；展示了宪法法院裁决在缓解政治不确定性中的重要作用。

title: Queuing, Service Time, and Price Dynamics in Residential Mortgage Lending
affiliations: and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Queuing, Service Time, and Price Dynamics in Residential Mortgage Lending

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Building on queuing theory, we develop and empirically validate a novel theoretical model of residential mortgage supply. Our model gives insight into how the stochastic arrival and sequential servicing of loan applications affect mortgage origination. The model provides closedform predictions for lenders’ optimal response to changes in the level and price elasticity of mortgage demand. Using confidential HMDA data, we estimate that a one standard deviation increase in mortgage demand raises mortgage rate spreads by 3 to 8 basis points, loan quantities by 20 to 32 percent, and application processing times by 3 to 5 days. We also provide empirical evidence for the model prediction that a higher elasticity of mortgage demand moderates price increases due to demand shocks, which can limit lenders’ exploitation of their market power.

AI.tldr: 基于排队理论构建住宅抵押贷款供给模型，实证验证需求冲击对贷款利率、贷款数量和审批时间的影响。
AI.research_question: 抵押贷款需求的变化如何影响贷款利率、贷款数量和申请处理时间？需求弹性如何调节贷款机构的市场力量？
AI.motivation: 理解抵押贷款市场中需求冲击对供给方行为的影响机制，特别是贷款机构如何通过定价、数量和审批时间调整来应对需求变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队理论，特别是随机到达和顺序服务模型，用于分析抵押贷款申请的动态处理过程。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与实证检验相结合。使用保密HMDA数据进行实证估计，分析需求冲击对利率利差、贷款数量和处理时间的影响。
AI.findings: 一个标准差的需求增加会使：1）抵押贷款利率利差提高3-8个基点；2）贷款数量增加20-32%；3）申请处理时间延长3-5天。需求弹性越高，价格上升幅度越小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将排队理论应用于抵押贷款供给分析，提供了封闭形式的预测模型，揭示了贷款机构对需求变化的优化反应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解抵押贷款市场动态提供理论框架，帮助贷款机构优化运营策略，为借款人理解审批时间变化提供依据。

title: The Geometric Siphon II: Directional Properties
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Geometric Siphon II: Directional Properties
detail.abstract:
In a companion paper (Ryan, 2026a), I identified the Geometric Siphon, a mechanism by which concentrated liquidity (CL) positions sharing depositor-level token balances produce inter-position capital transfers when autonomously rebalanced. The geometric mismatch between consecutive tick ranges generates token residuals that flow through shared balances. This paper extends that framework with three new theorems characterising the directional properties of the residual. 

Theorem 4 (Residual Monotonicity). The absolute geometric residual |∆R| increases monotonically with displacement from the range midpoint. Verified across 8 displacement levels with zero violations. 

Theorem 5 (Directional Asymmetry). For volatile/stablecoin pairs, symmetric sqrt-price displacements produce asymmetric USD-valued position outcomes. The up-move position retains strictly more USD value than the down-move position at all in-range displacement magnitudes. Verified across 5 displacement levels with zero violations. Empirically, rising markets produce 5× larger USD-denominated dust flow than falling markets across 26,191 events, despite near-identical frequency of positive dust events (35.6% vs 36.2%). The asymmetry is numéraire-dependent and reverses when measured in token0 units. 

Theorem 6 (Exit Asymmetry). For volatile/stablecoin pairs, below-range exits retain less USD value than above-range exits at symmetric sqrt-price displacement past the boundary. This follows from the 1/s nonlinearity in the V3 token0 amount equation. Verified with 10/10 Foundry confirmations. Empirically, below exits produce 58% larger average negative dust flow than above exits across 2,225 events.

Empirical validation spans 36,337 rebalance events across 58 positions and 18 days of continuous operation on Aerodrome (Base).

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了几何虹吸机制的理论框架，提出了三个新定理来表征集中流动性头寸间资本转移的方向性特征，并通过实证数据验证了这些理论发现。
AI.research_question: 集中流动性头寸在自主再平衡过程中产生的几何残差具有怎样的方向性特征？这些特征如何影响不同市场条件下的资本转移模式？
AI.motivation: 在前期研究中发现了几何虹吸机制，但对其方向性特征缺乏系统分析。理解这些方向性特征对于预测资本流动、优化流动性提供策略以及管理风险具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何虹吸理论框架，基于Uniswap V3集中流动性机制，分析连续tick范围间的几何不匹配产生的代币残差流动。
AI.method: 理论推导与实证验证相结合：1）通过数学定理形式化三个方向性特征；2）使用Foundry进行理论验证；3）基于Aerodrome（Base）上58个头寸、18天连续操作的36,337次再平衡事件进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1）几何残差绝对值随偏离范围中点距离单调增加；2）波动币/稳定币对中，对称sqrt-price位移产生不对称的USD价值结果，上涨市场产生的USD价值残差是下跌市场的5倍；3）低于范围退出的USD价值损失比高于范围退出大58%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）形式化了几何虹吸的方向性特征；2）揭示了numéraire依赖的不对称性；3）证明了V3代币数量方程的非线性导致的退出不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为流动性提供者提供了预测资本流动的工具；2）揭示了不同市场条件下的风险不对称性；3）为优化再平衡策略提供了理论依据。

title: Business Owner Wealth and the Credit Channel of Monetary Policy
affiliations: Audencia Business School, European Central Bank (ECB),  and University of Zurich - Department Finance

detail.title: Business Owner Wealth and the Credit Channel of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: Using data on small business owners' private wealth, firm loan applications, and credit scores, we show that monetary policy's impact on credit access depends heavily on owner wealth. Controlling for firm quality, expansionary policy significantly boosts loan approvals for low-wealth owners, but not their high-wealth counterparts. Because securing a loan enables owners to build future wealth, this credit channel carries clear distributional consequences. Survey data from 19 euro area countries corroborate these findings, revealing that the effect transmits primarily through weakly capitalized and less liquid banks.

AI.tldr: 货币政策对小微企业信贷获取的影响取决于企业主个人财富水平。扩张性货币政策显著提高低财富企业主的贷款获批率，但对高财富企业主影响不大，这通过资本不足和流动性较差的银行传导，具有明显的分配效应。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何影响不同财富水平的小微企业主的信贷获取？这种影响的传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策对小微企业信贷获取的异质性影响，特别是考虑企业主个人财富的作用，对于评估货币政策的分配效应和设计更有效的政策工具具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷渠道理论、银行资本约束理论、信息不对称理论（企业主财富作为信号机制）
AI.method: 使用小微企业主个人财富数据、企业贷款申请数据和信用评分数据，控制企业质量后分析货币政策对不同财富水平企业主贷款获批的影响；使用19个欧元区国家的调查数据验证结果，并分析银行资本和流动性状况的传导作用。
AI.findings: 1. 扩张性货币政策显著提高低财富企业主的贷款获批率，但对高财富企业主影响不大；2. 这种效应主要通过资本不足和流动性较差的银行传导；3. 获得贷款有助于企业主积累未来财富，因此货币政策具有明显的分配效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将企业主个人财富纳入货币政策信贷渠道分析框架；2. 揭示货币政策对不同财富群体的异质性影响；3. 阐明银行资本和流动性状况在传导机制中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行设计更具包容性的货币政策提供依据；2. 帮助银行更好地评估货币政策环境下的信贷风险；3. 为小微企业主理解信贷获取条件提供参考；4. 为政策制定者考虑货币政策分配效应提供实证支持。

title: Multi-Objective Optimization of Healthcare Facility Location in Urban Networks: Balancing Efficiency and Social Equity in Delhi, India
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Multi-Objective Optimization of Healthcare Facility Location in Urban Networks: Balancing Efficiency and Social Equity in Delhi, India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no relevant financial or non-financial competing interests to report.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is entirely computational, relying on open-source spatial data (OpenStreetMap) and simulated socioeconomic parameters. No human participants, patients, or animal subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Urban healthcare accessibility remains a critical challenge in rapidly developing cities, where disparities in socioeconomic status often correlate with inequitable access to medical facilities. This study addresses the Uncapacitated Facility Location Problem for healthcare infrastructure planning in Delhi, India, using real-world road network data and multi-objective optimization techniques. A computational framework was developed that integrates OpenStreetMap road network data with simulated socioeconomic constraints to model healthcare accessibility under realistic traffic conditions. Two optimization approaches were implemented and compared: a greedy heuristic algorithm comparing efficiency-only versus equity-weighted objectives, and the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) for simultaneous multi-objective optimization. The NSGA-II approach generated a Pareto front of 100 optimal solutions, revealing a fundamental trade-off between minimizing average travel time (efficiency) and minimizing the Gini coefficient of travel times (equity). Results demonstrate that equity-weighted optimization shifts facility placement toward peripheral, lower-socioeconomic areas, reducing average travel time for underserved populations by up to 15% compared to efficiency-only solutions. The best compromise solution achieved an average travel time of 437.1 seconds with a Gini coefficient of 0.246, effectively balancing both objectives. This framework provides policymakers with quantitative tools for evidence-based healthcare infrastructure planning that explicitly incorporates social equity considerations.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对印度德里的医疗设施规划问题，开发了一个结合真实道路网络数据和社会经济约束的计算框架，通过多目标优化方法（贪婪启发式算法和NSGA-II）在效率和公平性之间寻找平衡，为政策制定者提供了基于证据的医疗基础设施规划工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在快速发展的城市中，通过医疗设施选址规划来平衡效率和公平性，特别是在社会经济地位差异导致医疗可及性不均等的背景下？
AI.motivation: 城市医疗可及性在快速发展城市中是一个关键挑战，社会经济地位差异往往导致医疗设施获取的不公平。特别是在像印度德里这样的城市，需要科学的规划方法来平衡效率和公平性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于无容量限制设施选址问题（Uncapacitated Facility Location Problem）理论框架，结合多目标优化理论，特别是效率（最小化平均旅行时间）和公平性（最小化基尼系数）之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 开发了一个计算框架，整合OpenStreetMap道路网络数据和模拟的社会经济约束，在真实交通条件下建模医疗可及性。采用两种优化方法：1）贪婪启发式算法比较效率优先与公平加权目标；2）非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）进行同时多目标优化。
AI.findings: NSGA-II生成了包含100个最优解的帕累托前沿，揭示了最小化平均旅行时间（效率）和最小化旅行时间基尼系数（公平性）之间的基本权衡。公平加权优化将设施布局转向外围、社会经济地位较低的地区，与服务不足人群相比效率优先解决方案，平均旅行时间最多减少15%。最佳折衷方案实现了437.1秒的平均旅行时间和0.246的基尼系数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将无容量限制设施选址问题扩展到包含公平性目标的多目标优化框架；2）通过帕累托前沿分析揭示了效率和公平性之间的量化权衡关系；3）为城市医疗设施规划提供了结合社会经济约束和真实交通条件的理论建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了基于证据的医疗基础设施规划定量工具；2）开发的计算框架可应用于其他城市的医疗设施规划；3）展示了公平性考虑如何具体影响设施布局决策；4）为城市管理者提供了平衡效率和公平性的具体解决方案。

title: Mandatory Pay Disclosures in Job Postings
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE), Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Economics (ESE),  and

detail.title: Mandatory Pay Disclosures in Job Postings
detail.abstract: We investigate the economic consequences of mandating salary range disclosures in job postings in Colorado, Washington, and California. We find a sizable increase in salary range disclosure, although 25 percent of job postings appear to omit pay information post-mandate. However, this non-disclosure does not appear to be strategically motivated, nor does the width of disclosed salary ranges vary with firms' incentives to provide uninformative ranges. In line with the informative nature of mandated pay disclosures, we find evidence of increased pay levels in general, and a reduction in gender pay gaps in particular, especially when pay transparency increases are more pronounced. Contrary to voiced concerns, we find no increase in biased pay perceptions. Finally, we document negative market reactions to the announcement of these mandates and an increase in firm-level expenses, suggesting that the mandates impose net costs onto regulated firms. Our findings offer nuanced insights into the multifaceted impacts of pay transparency laws, highlighting both their societal benefits and financial consequences for firms.

AI.tldr: 研究美国科罗拉多、华盛顿和加州强制薪资范围披露的经济后果，发现虽然披露增加但仍有25%职位未披露，披露信息具有信息性，能提高薪资水平并缩小性别薪资差距，但给企业带来净成本
AI.research_question: 强制薪资范围披露在招聘广告中的经济后果是什么？包括对薪资披露程度、薪资水平、性别薪资差距、市场反应和企业成本的影响
AI.motivation: 随着薪资透明度法规的普及，需要了解这些政策的多方面影响，包括对劳动力市场效率、薪资公平性以及企业成本的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、薪资透明度理论、劳动力市场效率理论、企业合规成本理论
AI.method: 实证研究，使用科罗拉多、华盛顿和加州实施薪资披露法规前后的招聘广告数据，分析披露率、薪资范围宽度、薪资水平变化、性别薪资差距，以及市场反应和企业成本数据
AI.findings: 1) 薪资范围披露显著增加，但25%职位仍不披露；2) 不披露行为非战略性，薪资范围宽度与企业提供无信息性范围的动机无关；3) 薪资水平普遍提高，性别薪资差距缩小，透明度越高效果越明显；4) 未发现偏见性薪资认知增加；5) 法规宣布时市场反应负面，企业层面费用增加，表明给企业带来净成本
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证薪资透明度法规的信息性作用；2) 揭示薪资披露的非战略性特征；3) 提供薪资透明度对薪资水平和性别差距影响的实证证据；4) 挑战关于薪资透明度可能增加偏见的担忧；5) 量化企业合规成本
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供薪资透明度法规效果评估；2) 帮助企业了解合规成本和潜在收益；3) 为求职者提供薪资透明度法规的实际影响信息；4) 为未来薪资透明度政策设计提供参考

title: Artificial Intelligence and Strategic M&A; in 2026: Capital Allocation, Valuation, and Market Structure

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Strategic M&A; in 2026: Capital Allocation, Valuation, and Market Structure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with Acquiry, a corporate advisory firm operating in the mergers and acquisitions sector. This paper is an independent academic analysis based exclusively on publicly available information and does not reference confidential client data. The views expressed are solely those of the author and do not constitute investment or advisory recommendations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relies exclusively on publicly available secondary data sources and does not involve human subjects, confidential information, or proprietary datasets. Accordingly, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conducted by the author. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: This working paper examines the influence of artificial intelligence classification on valuation dynamics and capital allocation in global technology mergers and acquisitions between 2022 and 2025. Using a sample of publicly disclosed transactions, the study compares enterprise value multiples across AI-native firms, AI-enabled incumbents, and non-AI technology companies. The analysis incorporates descriptive statistics and regression modelling to evaluate the relative explanatory power of revenue growth, EBITDA margins, and AI classification on observed valuation outcomes. The findings suggest that while AI exposure is associated with valuation dispersion, growth quality and margin profile remain more statistically significant determinants of transaction pricing. The paper further examines structural deal trends, including earnout design, regulatory scrutiny, and integration risk in AI-driven acquisitions. Implications are discussed for private equity sponsors, corporate acquirers, and policy observers evaluating capital allocation decisions in 2026. This paper relies exclusively on publicly available transaction data and institutional research.

AI.tldr: 该工作论文研究了2022-2025年全球科技并购中人工智能分类对估值动态和资本配置的影响。研究发现，虽然AI暴露与估值分散相关，但增长质量和利润率仍是交易定价更显著的统计决定因素。
AI.research_question: 人工智能分类如何影响全球科技并购中的估值动态和资本配置？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术快速发展，AI相关企业在并购市场中的估值溢价和资本配置模式需要系统研究，为投资者、收购方和政策制定者提供决策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业估值理论、资本配置理论、并购定价理论，结合AI技术对传统估值框架的影响分析。
AI.method: 使用2022-2025年公开披露的交易数据样本，比较AI原生企业、AI赋能现有企业和非AI科技公司的企业价值倍数。采用描述性统计和回归模型分析收入增长、EBITDA利润率和AI分类对估值结果的解释力。
AI.findings: AI暴露与估值分散相关，但增长质量和利润率仍是交易定价更显著的统计决定因素。同时分析了AI驱动收购中的或有支付设计、监管审查和整合风险等结构性交易趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI时代的企业估值理论，揭示了AI分类在并购定价中的相对重要性，为技术驱动型并购的估值框架提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私募股权基金、企业收购方和政策观察者提供2026年资本配置决策的实践指导，帮助识别AI相关并购中的价值驱动因素和风险。

title: Automated Market Making with Continuity: Liquidity, Price Discovery, and Adverse Selection
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, University of Houston - Department of Finance and The University of Texas at San Antonio, Alvarez College of Business

detail.title: Automated Market Making with Continuity: Liquidity, Price Discovery, and Adverse Selection
detail.abstract: Constant-Product Automated Market Makers (CPAMMs) are an established mechanism for trading crypto-assets and may soon support trading of tokenized equities. We develop a minimal-structure model in which traders' strategies and valuations are continuous. Despite its simplicity, the model delivers a rich set of sharp predictions. CPAMM markets provide incentives for perfectly competitive liquidity provision. Equilibrium prices are invariant to liquidity supply. Traders' valuations can be recovered linearly from reserves and transaction prices, allowing variation in traders' motivations to be decomposed into information-driven and liquidity-driven trading components. A simple equilibrium relation links liquidity provision, price spreads, and price impact; and the model provides a closedform measure of expected adverse selection costs. We test these predictions using Uniswap V2 as the CPAMM market and Binance as the alternative market. Consistent with the theory, Uniswap reserves Granger-predict trading volume, estimated relationships among reserves, price spreads, and slippage have the predicted signs, and adverse selection costs are positively related to the variance of the permanent (information-driven) component of valuations.

AI.tldr: CPAMM市场（如Uniswap）在连续交易者策略和估值的简化模型中，显示出流动性供给不影响均衡价格，交易者估值可从储备和交易价格线性恢复，并可分解为信息驱动和流动性驱动交易。模型预测了流动性供给、价差和价格影响之间的均衡关系，并提供了预期逆向选择成本的闭式解。实证检验支持这些预测。
AI.research_question: 恒定乘积自动做市商（CPAMM）市场如何影响交易者行为、价格形成和流动性供给？CPAMM市场的均衡特性、交易动机分解以及逆向选择成本如何量化？
AI.motivation: CPAMM已成为加密资产交易的重要机制，并可能支持代币化股票交易。然而，对CPAMM市场均衡特性、交易者行为以及市场效率的系统性理论分析仍然缺乏。需要理解CPAMM如何影响价格发现、流动性供给和交易动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于连续交易者策略和估值的简约结构模型，分析CPAMM市场的均衡特性。理论框架包括：完美竞争流动性供给激励、价格不变性定理、交易者估值线性恢复、交易动机分解（信息驱动vs流动性驱动）、流动性供给-价差-价格影响均衡关系、逆向选择成本闭式解。
AI.method: 1. 理论建模：构建连续交易者策略和估值的简约CPAMM模型；2. 理论推导：分析均衡特性、价格不变性、估值恢复、交易分解等；3. 实证检验：使用Uniswap V2作为CPAMM市场，Binance作为对照市场，检验理论预测，包括格兰杰因果检验、回归分析等。
AI.findings: 1. CPAMM市场为完美竞争流动性供给提供激励；2. 均衡价格对流动性供给不变；3. 交易者估值可从储备和交易价格线性恢复；4. 交易动机可分解为信息驱动和流动性驱动成分；5. 流动性供给、价差和价格影响存在简单均衡关系；6. 逆向选择成本与估值永久性（信息驱动）成分的方差正相关；7. 实证支持：Uniswap储备格兰杰预测交易量，储备-价差-滑点关系符合预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次为CPAMM市场提供简约但丰富的均衡理论框架；2. 证明价格不变性定理；3. 提出交易者估值线性恢复和交易动机分解方法；4. 建立流动性供给-价差-价格影响均衡关系；5. 提供逆向选择成本的闭式解；6. 为CPAMM市场效率分析提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为流动性提供者提供激励设计和风险管理工具；2. 为交易者提供交易策略和成本分析框架；3. 为监管者提供CPAMM市场效率评估方法；4. 为DeFi协议设计者提供市场机制优化指导；5. 实证方法可用于实际市场监控和套利机会识别。

title: Predicting Cost-Related Delays in Medical Care: A Temporally Validated, Fairness-Aware Machine Learning Analysis of CDC BRFSS Data (2016-2022)
affiliations: Yee Collins Research Group and

detail.title: Predicting Cost-Related Delays in Medical Care: A Temporally Validated, Fairness-Aware Machine Learning Analysis of CDC BRFSS Data (2016-2022)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: The computer utilized was Eric Lee's personal computer to run all the code necessary. The data is open source on the cdc.gov website.

detail.abstract: Cost-related delays in medical care represent a persistent and inequitably distributed barrier to health access in the United States. We present a reproducible machine learning pipeline trained on four cycles of the CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS; 2016-2019; N ≈ 2.1 million) and evaluated via strict temporal holdout on the 2022 survey (N = 443,523; survey-weighted prevalence = 11.1%). Three classifiers-logistic regression, random forest, and LightGBM-were trained with survey-weighted cross-validation and isotonic calibration. All models achieved test-set AUROC of 0.788-0.792 (bootstrap 95% CIs spanning ≤ 0.01), with ∆AUROC < 0.005 from cross-validation, confirming low temporal drift over 2016-2022. Decision curve analysis shows positive net benefit across a clinically relevant threshold range of 5-35%. Fairness analysis revealed systematic disparities: AUROC ranged from 0.719 to 0.804 across racial/ethnic subgroups and from 0.760 to 0.795 across income strata, with consistent gradients across all three model families. SHAP attribution identified age, income, insurance status, and-most notably-survey non-response on the mental health item as the dominant predictors, surfacing informative missingness as an underappreciated signal in population health surveys. These findings demonstrate that cost-related access barriers are predictable and temporally stable, but that a globally trained model distributes predictive accuracy inequitably across demographic subgroups.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个可重复的机器学习流程，用于预测美国医疗成本相关延迟问题。基于2016-2019年CDC行为风险因素监测系统数据（N≈210万）训练模型，并在2022年数据（N=443,523）上评估。研究发现成本相关医疗障碍具有可预测性和时间稳定性，但模型在不同人口亚组中的预测准确性存在系统性差异。
AI.research_question: 医疗成本相关延迟问题是否可以通过机器学习模型进行预测？这些预测模型在不同人口亚组中的表现是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 医疗成本相关延迟是美国医疗可及性中持续存在且分布不均的障碍，需要开发可预测的工具来识别高风险人群并解决医疗不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗可及性理论、健康不平等理论、机器学习公平性理论、人口健康调查中的信息缺失理论
AI.method: 使用CDC行为风险因素监测系统2016-2019年数据（N≈210万）训练三种分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、LightGBM），采用调查加权交叉验证和等渗校准，在2022年数据（N=443,523）上进行严格时间保留测试，并进行公平性分析和SHAP归因分析。
AI.findings: 所有模型测试集AUROC为0.788-0.792，时间漂移小（∆AUROC < 0.005）。决策曲线分析显示在5-35%临床相关阈值范围内有正向净收益。公平性分析揭示系统性差异：种族/民族亚组AUROC为0.719-0.804，收入阶层为0.760-0.795。SHAP识别年龄、收入、保险状态和心理健康项目无应答为主要预测因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明医疗成本相关障碍具有可预测性和时间稳定性；2) 揭示全局训练的模型在不同人口亚组中预测准确性分布不均；3) 发现调查无应答（特别是心理健康项目）作为人口健康调查中被低估的重要信号。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供可重复的机器学习流程用于预测医疗成本相关延迟；2) 识别高风险人群特征（年龄、收入、保险状态、调查无应答）；3) 为政策制定者提供工具来针对性地解决医疗不平等问题；4) 强调在医疗预测模型中需要考虑公平性问题。

title: The Fokker-Planck Calculus in Quantitative Finance
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: The Fokker-Planck Calculus in Quantitative Finance
detail.abstract: This paper develops a rigorous, unified framework for Fokker-Planck methods in quantitative finance, organized around four structurally distinct analytical regimes. First, in the reversible spectral regime, we establish that generator self-adjointness on L 2 (π θ) holds if and only if the diffusion satisfies a divergence-form reversibility condition, yielding a complete Schrödinger spectral theory with exponential convergence at the Poincaré rate. Second, for the CIR-Laguerre regime, we show that every one-dimensional diffusion is inherently reversible with respect to its speed measure, requiring no Doob h-transform; a simple rescaling reduces the CIR generator to the classical Laguerre operator with explicit spectral expansions. Third, in the affine-Fourier regime, we provide a corrected derivation of the Heston Riccati system, restoring the missing log-price drift term and placing the factor iw exclusively in the initial condition. Fourth, the signature-generator correspondence is established via Dynkin's formula and Ni's backward PDE hierarchy, clarifying that higher-level expected signatures cannot be obtained by naive semigroup factorization due to quadratic variation effects. Additional contributions include a four-term spectral Fisher information formula, the JKO variational structure with non-constant mobility, and a local convergence theorem for natural-gradient calibration. Several errors in recent literature are identified and corrected throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文为量化金融中的Fokker-Planck方法建立了一个严谨统一的分析框架，围绕四个结构不同的分析体系展开，纠正了近期文献中的多个错误。
AI.research_question: 如何为量化金融中的Fokker-Planck方法建立一个严谨统一的分析框架，涵盖不同的扩散过程和相应的数学结构？
AI.motivation: 现有文献中Fokker-Planck方法在量化金融应用中的分析框架不够统一，存在理论推导错误和概念混淆，需要建立严谨的数学基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Fokker-Planck方程、扩散过程理论、谱理论、Schrödinger算子理论、Laguerre多项式、Fourier分析、Dynkin公式和签名过程理论。
AI.method: 采用数学分析框架，分为四个分析体系：可逆谱体系、CIR-Laguerre体系、仿射-Fourier体系、签名-生成元对应体系，通过严格数学推导建立理论结果。
AI.findings: 1) 建立了生成元自伴性的充要条件；2) 证明一维扩散相对于其速度测度本质可逆；3) 纠正了Heston Riccati系统的推导；4) 建立了签名-生成元对应关系；5) 提出了四项谱Fisher信息公式等新结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 统一的Fokker-Planck分析框架；2) 四个分析体系的数学基础；3) 纠正了文献中的理论错误；4) 新的数学公式和定理；5) 澄清了概念混淆。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为量化金融模型提供更准确的数学工具；2) 改进模型校准方法；3) 提高数值方法的理论基础；4) 为风险管理提供更可靠的数学框架。

title: LXMQ: A Decision Operating System for the U.S. Credit Card Economy

detail.title: LXMQ: A Decision Operating System for the U.S. Credit Card Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper, except that the paper discusses technical constructs associated with pending/provisional intellectual property related to LXMQ.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This working paper does not report research involving patients, clinical data, or human-participant experimentation requiring ethics-board approval. It is a systems and architecture paper based on public sources, conceptual modeling, and the author’s original technical framework.
declarations.funderStatement: No external grant funding supported this working paper.

detail.abstract: The U.S. credit-card economy is a platform-scale decision system. Still, it lacks a neutral decision operating system (Decision OS) at the two moments when value is created and allocated: checkout (which payment instrument is used, and which offer/reward is captured) and repayment (which balances are revolved, paid down, or refinanced, and when). In 2024 alone, consumer credit card purchase volume reached $3.6T and balances exceeded $1.2T, while consumers were assessed $160B in interest charges and paid $31.3B in fees (including $17B in late fees), reflecting record APRs and increasing minimum-payment behavior [1]. In parallel, merchants paid $187.20B in card-acceptance fees to accept $11.902T in card payments, underscoring that checkout is already supported by enormous, ongoing budgets [2]. This paper proposes LXMQ, a Decision OS that routes value across the consumer issuer merchant ecosystem via a unified financial hypergraph (consumer card merchant entities and events) and a six-algorithm architecture: (i) a unified data fabric and feature graph; (ii) an adaptive spend optimizer at checkout; (iii) a dynamic pay-down scheduler for multi-card repayment; (iv) a neural rewards amplifier for valuation-aware points redemption; (v) a predictive fee-alert guardian; and (vi) a real-time credit health predictor and simulator. LXMQ is positioned as an infrastructure-layer system that can be distributed directly to consumers or embedded via partner applications, aligning with emerging standardized data-access regimes [3].

AI.tldr: 本文提出LXMQ决策操作系统，旨在解决美国信用卡经济中缺乏中立决策系统的问题，通过统一金融超图和六算法架构优化消费和还款决策。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个中立的决策操作系统（Decision OS）来优化美国信用卡经济中的价值创造和分配过程？
AI.motivation: 美国信用卡经济规模巨大（2024年消费额3.6万亿美元，余额1.2万亿美元），但缺乏中立决策系统，导致消费者支付高额利息和费用（1600亿美元利息，313亿美元费用），商户支付巨额接受费用（1872亿美元）。现有系统在消费和还款两个关键价值创造节点上效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台规模决策系统理论、金融超图理论、消费者-发卡机构-商户生态系统理论、标准化数据访问制度理论。
AI.method: 提出LXMQ决策操作系统架构，包含：统一数据结构和特征图、自适应消费优化器、动态多卡还款调度器、神经奖励放大器、预测性费用警报守护者、实时信用健康预测器和模拟器。
AI.findings: LXMQ系统能够通过统一金融超图（消费者-卡-商户实体和事件）和六算法架构，在基础设施层面优化价值路由，可直接分发给消费者或通过合作伙伴应用嵌入。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出信用卡经济中决策操作系统的理论框架；2）建立金融超图作为价值路由的基础数据结构；3）构建六算法协同的决策系统架构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为消费者节省利息和费用支出；2）优化商户支付接受成本；3）提供可直接部署的决策操作系统；4）符合新兴标准化数据访问制度，便于实施。

title: The Nexus between the Deposit and Risk-Taking Channels of Monetary Policy
affiliations: Banco de España, Banco de España and Banco de España

detail.title: The Nexus between the Deposit and Risk-Taking Channels of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: This paper examines the deposit channel of monetary policy during the fastest and most intense tightening cycle of the Euro era. Using the universal Spanish credit register and regional variation in deposit market concentration, we show that limited pass-through of policy rates to deposit rates-driven by banks' regional market power-produces heterogeneous effects on bank credit supply and risk-taking. Following the tightening cycle, banks operating in more concentrated deposit markets reduced credit more sharply to riskier firms. For newly originated loans, this contraction was accompanied by higher interest rates and improved realized returns. We document a novel dimension of the deposit channel: it compels banks to actively optimize their risk-return trade-off. Our results show that preserving deposit franchise value leads banks to prioritize prudence, reversing the "search-for-yield" dynamic observed during the zero-lower-bound era.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧元时代最快最激烈的紧缩周期中货币政策的存款渠道。利用西班牙全面的信贷登记数据和存款市场集中度的区域差异，研究发现：由于银行区域市场力量导致的政策利率向存款利率的有限传导，对银行信贷供给和风险承担产生了异质性影响。在紧缩周期后，在更集中的存款市场运营的银行对风险较高的企业信贷收缩更剧烈。对于新发放贷款，这种收缩伴随着更高的利率和改善的实际回报。研究记录了一个新的存款渠道维度：它迫使银行积极优化其风险-收益权衡。
AI.research_question: 在欧元时代最快最激烈的货币紧缩周期中，存款市场集中度如何通过存款渠道影响银行的信贷供给和风险承担行为？
AI.motivation: 研究欧元区历史上最快速、最激烈的货币政策紧缩周期中，存款渠道如何运作，特别是存款市场集中度如何影响银行对政策利率变化的反应，以及这种影响如何传导到信贷供给和风险承担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存款渠道理论、银行市场力量理论、风险-收益权衡理论、信贷供给理论
AI.method: 使用西班牙全面的信贷登记数据（universal Spanish credit register），结合存款市场集中度的区域差异进行实证分析，考察货币政策紧缩周期中银行信贷供给和风险承担的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 在存款市场更集中的地区，政策利率向存款利率的传导更有限；2. 这些地区的银行在紧缩周期后对风险较高的企业信贷收缩更剧烈；3. 新发放贷款的利率更高，实际回报改善；4. 存款渠道迫使银行主动优化风险-收益权衡；5. 保持存款特许价值使银行优先考虑审慎，逆转了零利率下限时期的"追逐收益"动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了存款渠道的一个新维度：迫使银行主动优化风险-收益权衡；2. 提供了存款市场集中度通过存款渠道影响银行行为的实证证据；3. 展示了货币政策传导在不同市场结构下的异质性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构理解货币政策传导机制提供了新视角；2. 有助于政策制定者考虑存款市场结构对货币政策效果的影响；3. 为银行风险管理提供了实证依据，特别是在紧缩周期中的信贷决策。

title: Emotion in Euro Area Monetary Policy Communication and Bond Yields: The Draghi Era
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank and Wilfrid Laurier University - School of Business & Economics

detail.title: Emotion in Euro Area Monetary Policy Communication and Bond Yields: The Draghi Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views expressed in this paper are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the opinions of the Deutsche Bundesbank or the Eurosystem.The corresponding authors of this manuscript certify that the contributors' and conflicts of interest statements included in this paper are correct and have been approved by all co-authors.

detail.abstract: We combine modern methods from Speech Emotion Recognition and Natural Language Processing with high-frequency financial data to analyze how the vocal emotions and language of ECB President Mario Draghi affect the yields and yield spreads of major euro area economies. This novel approach to central bank communication reveals that vocal and verbal emotions significantly impact the yield curve, with effects varying in magnitude and direction. Our results reveal an important asymmetry in yield changes with positive signals raising German, French, and Spanish yields, while negative cues increase Italian yields. Our analysis of bond spreads and equity markets indicates that positive communication influences the risk-free yield component, whereas negative communication affects the risk premium. Additionally, our study contributes by constructing a synchronized dataset for voice and language analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合语音情感识别和自然语言处理技术，分析欧洲央行行长德拉吉的语音情感和语言表达如何影响欧元区主要经济体的收益率和收益率利差，发现情感信号对收益率曲线有显著影响且存在不对称效应。
AI.research_question: 欧洲央行行长德拉吉的语音情感和语言表达如何影响欧元区主要经济体的收益率和收益率利差？
AI.motivation: 传统央行沟通研究主要关注文字内容，而忽视了语音情感这一重要维度。本研究旨在填补这一空白，通过结合现代技术分析央行官员的语音情感如何影响金融市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合央行沟通理论、金融市场反应理论、情感信号传递理论，以及语音情感识别和自然语言处理的技术框架。
AI.method: 采用语音情感识别和自然语言处理技术分析德拉吉的公开讲话，结合高频金融数据（收益率和收益率利差），使用计量经济学方法检验情感信号对金融市场的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 语音和语言情感对收益率曲线有显著影响；2. 存在不对称效应：积极信号提高德国、法国、西班牙收益率，而消极信号提高意大利收益率；3. 积极沟通主要影响无风险收益率成分，消极沟通影响风险溢价；4. 构建了同步的语音和语言分析数据集。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将语音情感维度引入央行沟通研究；2. 揭示了情感信号对金融市场的非对称影响机制；3. 拓展了央行沟通影响金融市场的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行官员提供了沟通策略的实证依据；2. 为金融市场参与者提供了新的分析工具；3. 构建了可用于后续研究的同步数据集；4. 有助于理解不同国家债券市场的风险定价差异。

title: Assessing International Public Sector Accounting Standards Implementation Challenges and Public Financial Management Reforms in Ghana: Evidence from a Nationwide Survey of Public Sector Practitioners
affiliations: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning, Christian Service University College and Transilvania University of Brasov

detail.title: Assessing International Public Sector Accounting Standards Implementation Challenges and Public Financial Management Reforms in Ghana: Evidence from a Nationwide Survey of Public Sector Practitioners

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Human subjects: Consent was obtained or waived by all participants in this study. Ethical approval was secured from the Ethics Committee of Christian Service University College, Kumasi. Animal subjects: All authors have confirmed that this study did not involve animal subjects or tissue.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no funding.

detail.abstract: Introduction: The adoption of International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) is increasingly central to public financial management (PFM) reform agendas across sub-Saharan Africa. Ghana, which has invested substantially in PFM infrastructure-including the Ghana Integrated Financial Management Information System (GIFMIS)-represents an important case for understanding the practitioner-level experience of IPSAS implementation. Despite growing policy momentum, empirical evidence on the perceptions, challenges, and implementation outcomes from the perspective of frontline public sector professionals remains limited. This study examines the awareness, perceived benefits, implementation challenges, and outlook of IPSAS adoption among public sector practitioners in Ghana. It further investigates whether perceptions vary across organisation types and experience levels. Methods: A structured online questionnaire was administered to 400 public sector practitioners across five organisation types in Ghana (central government ministries, audit institutions, local governments, regulatory bodies, and public corporations). Quantitative data were analysed using Python (v3.12) with the pandas, NumPy, scipy, seaborn, and matplotlib libraries. Descriptive statistics (means, standard deviations, frequency distributions) one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA), and Pearson correlation analysis were computed for all survey items. Results: Respondents demonstrated strong awareness of IPSAS (M = 4.24) and broadly endorsed the necessity of PFM reforms (M = 4.70). IPSAS was perceived as a key component of Ghana's reform agenda (M = 4.48). Over 72.5% of respondents reported either full or partial IPSAS implementation in their organisations. Perceived benefits were consistently high across comparability (M = 4.52), reliability (M = 4.28), and donor confidence (M = 4.32). Principal implementation challenges included capacity and training deficits (M = 4.00), system incompatibility (M = 3.56), and legal/regulatory misalignment (M = 3.51). Outlook was strongly positive, with respondents anticipating IPSAS's contribution to international bestpractice alignment (M = 4.50) and fiscal discipline (M = 4.36). ANOVA revealed no statistically significant differences in perceptions across organisation types (p > 0.10), suggesting broad consensus. Discussion: Ghanaian public sector practitioners hold strongly favourable views towards IPSAS adoption. The primary barriers are systemic and structural-particularly inadequate training, technological incompatibility, and regulatory gaps-rather than fundamental disagreements about the value of reform. These findings carry important implications for policymakers seeking to accelerate IPSAS full adoption in Ghana and comparable low-and middle-income country contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查加纳公共部门从业人员对国际公共部门会计准则（IPSAS）采纳的认知、感知效益、实施挑战和展望。研究发现从业人员对IPSAS有高度认知和积极态度，主要实施障碍是能力培训不足、系统不兼容和法规不协调等结构性因素。
AI.research_question: 加纳公共部门从业人员对IPSAS采纳的认知、感知效益、实施挑战和展望是什么？这些认知是否因组织类型和经验水平而异？
AI.motivation: IPSAS采纳在撒哈拉以南非洲公共财政管理改革中日益重要，但缺乏从一线公共部门专业人员视角的实证证据。加纳作为在PFM基础设施（包括GIFMIS）投入大量资源的国家，是理解IPSAS实施实践层面经验的重要案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共部门会计准则采纳理论、公共财政管理改革理论、制度理论（关注实施障碍的结构性因素）
AI.method: 对加纳五类组织（中央政府部委、审计机构、地方政府、监管机构和公共企业）的400名公共部门从业人员进行结构化在线问卷调查。使用Python（v3.12）及pandas、NumPy、scipy、seaborn、matplotlib库进行数据分析，包括描述性统计、单因素方差分析和皮尔逊相关分析。
AI.findings: 1. 受访者对IPSAS有高度认知（M=4.24），广泛支持PFM改革的必要性（M=4.70）；2. 72.5%的受访者报告其组织已完全或部分实施IPSAS；3. 感知效益高：可比性（M=4.52）、可靠性（M=4.28）、捐助者信心（M=4.32）；4. 主要实施挑战：能力和培训不足（M=4.00）、系统不兼容（M=3.56）、法律/法规不协调（M=3.51）；5. 展望积极：预期IPSAS有助于国际最佳实践对接（M=4.50）和财政纪律（M=4.36）；6. 方差分析显示不同组织类型间认知无显著差异（p>0.10）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为IPSAS在低收入和中等收入国家实施提供了实证证据；2. 识别了结构性而非态度性障碍作为主要实施挑战；3. 验证了不同公共部门组织类型间对会计准则改革认知的一致性；4. 丰富了公共部门会计准则采纳理论在发展中国家背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为加纳政策制定者加速IPSAS全面采纳提供具体建议：加强能力建设、解决技术系统兼容性、协调法律法规；2. 为类似低收入和中等收入国家提供可借鉴的实施经验；3. 确认了从业人员对改革的积极态度，为政策推进提供支持；4. 指出了需要优先解决的结构性障碍而非改变从业人员态度。

title: Evaluation of the International Management of Mutual Funds
affiliations: and Universidad Europea de Madrid

detail.title: Evaluation of the International Management of Mutual Funds
detail.abstract: The collective investment industry has experienced significant growth in the last decade. Simultaneously, there has been a sharp increase in the internationalization of mutual fund portfolios. In this context, the objective of this study is to analyze, in 35 countries around the world, the relationship between the degree of internationalization of the portfolio and the level of fund efficiency. Different performance measures, or results evaluations, are applied to portfolio management. The results reveal significant differences in fund efficiency, with domestic funds achieving better results than international funds. However, when considering the effect of size, the results show a negative (positive) relationship between the degree of internationalization of the fund and its efficiency for lower (higher) levels of assets. Furthermore, in aggregate terms, no synchronization capacity of the funds is evident. However, it is found that the ability to synchronize with the international market is lower than that with the domestic market.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了35个国家共同基金国际化程度与基金效率的关系，发现国内基金表现优于国际基金，且基金规模对国际化与效率的关系有调节作用
AI.research_question: 共同基金投资组合的国际化程度如何影响基金效率？
AI.motivation: 集体投资行业在过去十年显著增长，同时共同基金投资组合国际化程度急剧上升，需要研究国际化对基金效率的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合国际化理论、基金效率评估理论、规模效应理论
AI.method: 对35个国家的共同基金进行实证分析，应用不同的绩效衡量指标评估投资组合管理效果
AI.findings: 1) 国内基金效率显著优于国际基金；2) 规模调节作用：资产规模较低时，国际化程度与效率负相关；资产规模较高时，国际化程度与效率正相关；3) 基金总体上缺乏同步化能力；4) 与国际市场的同步化能力低于与国内市场的同步化能力
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了国际化程度与基金效率的非线性关系；2) 发现了规模对国际化-效率关系的调节作用；3) 提供了基金同步化能力的跨国比较证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为基金管理者提供国际化投资策略的决策依据；2) 帮助投资者根据基金规模选择国际化程度合适的基金；3) 为监管机构理解基金国际化趋势提供实证支持

title: ML-Based ESG Score Prediction in Indian Banking Sector and Finance Sector (2015-2025)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: ML-Based ESG Score Prediction in Indian Banking Sector and Finance Sector (2015-2025)
detail.abstract:
This research analyzes and develops machine learning models that will predict the ESG score for 48 of the largest banks and non-banking financial companies in India between 2015 and 2025 (528 firm-years). The models use various data types (such as financial metrics, governance, regulatory compliance and trends over time). The machine learning model used, XGBoost, produced significantly better results than traditional linear regression models when predicting the ESG score of the corresponding firms with an R² of 0.79, a RMSE of 4.7 and a MAE of 3.6 based on out-of-time test data (2023 through 2025).

SHAP analysis has identified that the primary drivers of ESG performance are board independence (21.8%), firm size (18.4%), regulatory trends (15.2%) and return on assets (12.7%) respectively. When comparing private sector banks to public sector banks, the private sector banks' ESG scores were better on average by 8 to 15 ESG points (68.4 vs 55.7). The ESG scores of the entire sector have increased 51% (47.2 to 71.5) over the period from 2015 to 2025, primarily due to the introduction of SEBI's BRSR framework (2021) and RBI's climate risk guidelines.

The results of this research allow for data-driven forecasts of ESG performance in emerging markets that are developing new disclosure requirements, and thus provide valuable information for investors, regulators and financial institutions. Limitations of this study include data sparsity prior to 2022, possible endogeneity between financial performance and ESG scores, and methodological differences across agencies.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了XGBoost机器学习模型预测印度48家最大银行和非银行金融机构的ESG评分（2015-2025年），模型表现显著优于传统线性回归（R²=0.79）。研究发现董事会独立性、公司规模、监管趋势和资产回报率是ESG表现的主要驱动因素，私营银行ESG评分平均高于公营银行8-15分，整个行业ESG评分在2015-2025年间增长了51%。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习模型准确预测印度大型银行和非银行金融机构的ESG评分？哪些因素对ESG表现影响最大？私营银行和公营银行的ESG表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着新兴市场ESG披露要求的发展，投资者、监管机构和金融机构需要数据驱动的ESG绩效预测工具。传统线性回归方法在预测ESG评分方面存在局限性，而机器学习方法可能提供更准确的预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG（环境、社会和治理）理论框架，结合公司治理理论、利益相关者理论和制度理论，探讨金融指标、治理结构、监管合规等因素对ESG表现的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用XGBoost机器学习模型，分析48家印度最大银行和非银行金融机构2015-2025年（528个公司年度）的数据，包括财务指标、治理结构、监管合规和时间趋势等变量。采用SHAP分析识别关键驱动因素，并与传统线性回归模型进行性能比较。
AI.findings: 1. XGBoost模型预测性能显著优于线性回归（R²=0.79，RMSE=4.7，MAE=3.6）；2. 主要ESG驱动因素：董事会独立性（21.8%）、公司规模（18.4%）、监管趋势（15.2%）、资产回报率（12.7%）；3. 私营银行ESG评分平均比公营银行高8-15分（68.4 vs 55.7）；4. 2015-2025年整个行业ESG评分增长51%（47.2到71.5），主要受SEBI的BRSR框架和RBI气候风险指南推动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了机器学习方法在ESG预测中的有效性；2. 识别了新兴市场金融机构ESG表现的关键驱动因素；3. 揭示了监管政策（如BRSR框架）对ESG表现的显著影响；4. 提供了私营与公营金融机构ESG表现差异的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者、监管机构和金融机构提供数据驱动的ESG预测工具；2. 帮助金融机构识别提升ESG表现的关键杠杆点；3. 为新兴市场ESG监管政策制定提供实证依据；4. 支持金融机构在ESG转型中的战略决策。

title: The Spatial Incidence of Hyperscale Data Centers
affiliations: , , University of Calgary - Finance and Business School, National University of Singapore

detail.title: The Spatial Incidence of Hyperscale Data Centers
detail.abstract: We estimate the local incidence of U.S. data center openings using stacked difference-in-differences design and nationwide housing transaction data. We find that hyperscale data centers--those owned and operated by large cloud/AI firms--reduce nearby house prices by 6.8 percent, with effects highly localized and fading beyond 14 km. These effects increase with power capacity and attenuate with prior local exposure. By contrast, large non-hyperscale facilities show little evidence of capitalization, suggesting that burden intensity alone is not sufficient. Taken together, our results indicate that the local incidence of digital infrastructure depends on operating model and siting context, not scale alone. These findings have direct implications for the evaluation of data center subsidies and siting policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用堆叠双重差分法和全国住房交易数据，发现超大规模数据中心（由大型云/AI公司运营）使附近房价下降6.8%，影响高度本地化且在14公里外消失。影响随电力容量增加而增强，随先前本地暴露而减弱。相比之下，大型非超大规模设施几乎没有资本化效应。
AI.research_question: 美国数据中心开放对当地房价的本地影响是什么？不同类型的数字基础设施（超大规模与非超大规模）对房地产市场的资本化效应有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着数字基础设施（特别是数据中心）的快速增长，地方政府经常提供补贴来吸引这些设施，但对其本地经济影响（特别是对房地产价值的影响）缺乏系统证据。需要了解不同运营模式（超大规模vs非超大规模）和选址背景如何影响本地负担分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于设施选址的本地负担理论，结合数字基础设施特有的运营特征（电力需求、噪音、交通等外部性），以及房地产资本化理论，分析不同类型数据中心对周边房价的差异化影响。
AI.method: 使用堆叠双重差分设计（stacked difference-in-differences），分析全国范围内的住房交易数据，比较数据中心开放前后处理组和对照组的房价变化，并考虑距离衰减效应。
AI.findings: 1. 超大规模数据中心使14公里内房价下降6.8%；2. 影响高度本地化，超过14公里影响消失；3. 影响随电力容量增加而增强；4. 影响随先前本地暴露而减弱；5. 大型非超大规模设施几乎没有资本化效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了设施选址的本地负担理论，强调运营模式（而不仅仅是规模）的重要性；2. 提供了数字基础设施本地影响的实证证据；3. 揭示了电力容量和先前暴露的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为地方政府评估数据中心补贴政策提供依据；2. 为数据中心选址决策提供参考；3. 帮助社区理解不同类型数字基础设施的本地影响差异；4. 为房地产投资者提供风险评估信息。

title: On Physician Overconfidence
affiliations: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine,  and University of Cologne - Faculty of Management, Economics and Social Sciences

detail.title: On Physician Overconfidence
detail.abstract: We study overconfidence and its consequences among 1,050 physicians in Ghana, representing about 10 percent of the country's physician workforce. Using a lab-in-the-field experiment with incentivized clinical vignettes and beliefs about relative performance, we find that 47 percent of physicians are overconfident. We observe that overconfidence is at least partly formed rationally, as tests fail to reject Bayesian updating while posterior beliefs are better calibrated than priors. We obtain evidence for motivated beliefs as a driver of overconfidence as physicians selectively seek feedback about their performance, especially when they expect to have performed well. This pattern is strongest among the overconfident and consistent with self-image concerns. Physicians also exhibit strong social image concerns, albeit these concerns are not limited to the overconfident. Overall, physician overconfidence appears closely tied to self-image motivesthe intrinsic desire to be a good doctor-and does not reduce performance. Important consequences of physician overconfidence for the use of clinical decision-support systems and team decision rules are also investigated.

AI.tldr: 研究加纳1050名医生（约占该国医生总数的10%）的过度自信及其后果。通过实验室实地实验发现47%的医生存在过度自信，这种过度自信部分源于理性形成（符合贝叶斯更新），部分源于动机性信念（选择性寻求反馈）。医生过度自信与自我形象动机（想成为好医生）密切相关，不影响实际表现，但对临床决策支持系统和团队决策规则的使用有重要影响。
AI.research_question: 医生过度自信的程度、形成机制及其对医疗决策和绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解医疗专业人员的过度自信现象，特别是在发展中国家医疗环境中的表现，以及这种认知偏差如何影响临床决策和医疗质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学理论，结合贝叶斯更新、动机性信念、自我形象和社会形象关注等概念，分析医生过度自信的形成机制。
AI.method: 实验室实地实验，涉及1050名加纳医生，使用激励性临床案例和相对绩效信念测量，分析医生的先验信念、后验信念和反馈寻求行为。
AI.findings: 1）47%的医生存在过度自信；2）过度自信部分理性形成（符合贝叶斯更新，后验信念比先验信念更准确）；3）动机性信念驱动过度自信（医生选择性寻求反馈，特别是预期表现良好时）；4）过度自信与自我形象动机相关，但不影响实际表现；5）医生表现出强烈的社会形象关注。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）在发展中国家医疗环境中验证了过度自信理论；2）区分了理性形成和动机性信念在过度自信中的作用；3）揭示了自我形象和社会形象关注在专业决策中的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为医疗管理提供实证依据，说明医生过度自信不影响实际表现；2）对临床决策支持系统和团队决策规则的设计和实施有重要启示；3）为医疗专业人员的培训和反馈机制提供指导。

title: Data Assets and Firm Value
affiliations: Fudan University - School of Management, Fudan University - School of Management and

detail.title: Data Assets and Firm Value

declarations.funderStatement: Jiang acknowledges support from the Eli Broad Professorship; Huang acknowledges support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant Nos. 72241425, 72172038 and 72572039, respectively), the Sci-Tech Innovation Foundation of School of Management at Fudan University, and the Research Fund of Shanghai Data Exchange Corporation.

detail.abstract: We examine the equity market and real effects of mandatory data asset recognition using a regulatory shock in China. On August 21, 2023, China's Ministry of Finance issued the Data Resource Interim Provisions, requiring listed firms to recognize qualifying data resources as balance sheet assets — the first such mandate globally — effective January 1, 2024. Using this mandate as a quasi-natural experiment, we find that data-asset firms realize a 2.11 percent cumulative abnormal return over a four-day event window. The effect is stronger for financially constrained firms, firms with higher SG&A and R&D expenditures, state-owned enterprises, and firms with more advanced digital transformation, consistent with investors anticipating real economic benefits rather than mere accounting reclassification. Data-asset firms subsequently experience improved financing access, increased investment in R&D and organizational capital, and better operating performance. Financial statement data from 2024Q1 to 2025Q3 document rapid growth in data asset recognition, with limited balance sheet effects but meaningful impacts on operating expenses and earnings. Our findings inform ongoing global standard-setting debates on internally generated intangibles and suggest that the economic consequences of recognition depend critically on the surrounding institutional environment.

AI.tldr: 中国财政部2023年8月发布《数据资源暂行规定》，要求上市公司将符合条件的数据资源确认为资产负债表资产，这是全球首个此类强制规定。研究发现，数据资产公司在四天事件窗口内实现2.11%的累计异常回报，且随后获得更好的融资渠道、增加研发和组织资本投资，并改善经营绩效。
AI.research_question: 强制性数据资产确认对股票市场和实体经济有何影响？
AI.motivation: 中国财政部于2023年8月发布《数据资源暂行规定》，要求上市公司将符合条件的数据资源确认为资产负债表资产，这是全球首个此类强制规定。这一政策变化为研究数据资产确认的经济后果提供了独特的准自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论、融资约束理论和制度环境理论，研究数据资产确认如何通过改善信息环境、缓解融资约束来影响企业价值和经济活动。
AI.method: 采用事件研究法分析政策公告对股票市场的影响，使用双重差分法（DID）检验数据资产确认对融资、投资和经营绩效的因果效应，并利用2024年第一季度至2025年第三季度的财务报表数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 数据资产公司在四天事件窗口内实现2.11%的累计异常回报；2. 对融资约束严重、SG&A和研发支出较高、国有企业以及数字化转型更先进的公司影响更强；3. 数据资产公司随后获得更好的融资渠道、增加研发和组织资本投资，并改善经营绩效；4. 2024Q1-2025Q3数据显示数据资产确认快速增长，但对资产负债表影响有限，对经营费用和收益有实质性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为内部生成无形资产确认的经济后果提供了首个大规模实证证据；2. 表明确认的经济后果严重依赖于制度环境；3. 为全球无形资产会计准则制定提供了重要参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者评估数据资产确认政策效果提供依据；2. 帮助企业理解数据资产确认的战略价值；3. 为投资者评估数据资产公司的投资价值提供参考；4. 为全球其他国家和地区制定类似政策提供经验借鉴。

title: Racial Epithets And Title Vii Hostile Work Environment Claims: Case Commentary On Smith V. P.A.M. Transport (6TH CIR. 2025)
affiliations: University of New Mexico - School of Law and

detail.title: Racial Epithets And Title Vii Hostile Work Environment Claims: Case Commentary On Smith V. P.A.M. Transport (6TH CIR. 2025)
detail.abstract: In order to rule fairly in employment discrimination cases, courts cannot adhere to rigid categories of harassment. In Smith v. P.A.M. Transport, Inc., two plaintiffs sued their employer under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act after a supervisor of the same race as the employees referred to each of them by the term, “monkey ass.” The plaintiffs also claimed that their supervisors cursed, threatened, and shouted at them while treating white employees with respect. After the district court granted summary judgment in favor of the defendant, the Sixth Circuit reversed. The Sixth Circuit reasoned that “monkey ass” is a racial slur because of its history and usage, that employment discrimination plaintiffs do not need to prove the racial self-identification of workplace comparators, and that the race of the supervisor does not obviate the severity of the harassment without more evidence. In addition, we address the concurring opinion’s use of ChatGPT by exploring whether large language models can help courts determine the meanings of racially sensitive, composite phrases in the context of employment discrimination. Overall, the Sixth Circuit embraced an interpretation of Title VII that acknowledges the nuance and factual complexity of workplace interactions, thus allowing plaintiffs to articulate claims in language that is familiar to them.

AI.tldr: 第六巡回法院在Smith v. P.A.M. Transport案中推翻了地区法院的简易判决，认为"monkey ass"是种族歧视性言论，原告无需证明工作场所比较对象的种族自我认同，且主管的种族不能自动减轻骚扰的严重性。法院还探讨了ChatGPT等大型语言模型在帮助法庭理解种族敏感复合短语含义方面的潜在作用。
AI.research_question: 在就业歧视案件中，当主管与雇员同种族时，使用"monkey ass"等复合短语是否构成种族骚扰？法庭应如何解释这类种族敏感复合短语的含义？
AI.motivation: 传统就业歧视案件中对骚扰行为的分类过于僵化，无法充分反映工作场所互动的复杂性和细微差别。需要探索更灵活的解释框架，允许原告使用他们熟悉的语言表达诉求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 第七篇民权法案的解释理论；2) 种族骚扰的构成要件理论；3) 工作场所权力动态理论；4) 语言的社会建构理论；5) 比较对象分析框架
AI.method: 案例分析法：深入分析Smith v. P.A.M. Transport案的法律推理和判决逻辑；同时探讨ChatGPT等大型语言模型作为辅助工具在解释种族敏感复合短语方面的应用潜力
AI.findings: 1) "monkey ass"因其历史和用法被视为种族歧视性言论；2) 原告无需证明工作场所比较对象的种族自我认同；3) 主管与雇员同种族不能自动减轻骚扰的严重性；4) 大型语言模型可能帮助法庭理解种族敏感复合短语的语境含义
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发展了第七篇民权法案的灵活解释框架；2) 提出了工作场所骚扰的"事实复杂性"理论；3) 挑战了传统种族骚扰分类的僵化性；4) 探索了人工智能在法律解释中的理论应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为就业歧视原告提供了更有利的诉讼策略；2) 指导法庭如何评估种族敏感语言的含义；3) 为法律实务工作者提供了处理类似案件的分析框架；4) 展示了技术工具在法律解释中的潜在应用价值

title: Reserve Demand Estimation with Minimal Theory
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Reserve Demand Estimation with Minimal Theory

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Papers, volume 26, issue 07, 2026[10.21144/wp26-07]

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We propose a new reserve-demand estimation strategy—a middle ground between atheoretical reduced-form econometric approaches and fully structural quantitative-theoretic approaches. The strategy consists of an econometric specification that satisfies core restrictions implied by theory and controls for changes in administered-rate spreads that induce rotations and shifts in reserve demand. The resulting approach is as user-friendly as existing reduced-form econometric methods but improves upon them by incorporating a minimal set of theoretical restrictions that any reserve demand must satisfy. We apply this approach to U.S. data and obtain reserve-demand estimates that are broadly consistent with the structural estimates in Lagos and Navarro (2023).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的准备金需求估计策略，介于无理论基础的简化形式计量经济学方法和完全结构化的定量理论方法之间。该方法包含满足理论核心限制的计量规范，并控制导致准备金需求曲线旋转和移动的管理利率利差变化。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种既保持用户友好性又包含必要理论限制的准备金需求估计方法？
AI.motivation: 现有准备金需求估计方法存在两极分化：一方面是无理论基础的简化形式计量方法，另一方面是完全结构化的定量理论方法。需要一种折中方法，既保持用户友好性，又能纳入准备金需求必须满足的核心理论限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准备金需求理论，特别是Lagos和Navarro（2023）的结构模型。核心理论限制包括准备金需求必须满足的基本经济原理和约束条件。
AI.method: 提出一种新的计量经济学规范，该规范满足理论核心限制，并控制管理利率利差变化对准备金需求曲线的影响。这是一种介于简化形式和完全结构化方法之间的折中策略。
AI.findings: 将新方法应用于美国数据，得到的准备金需求估计结果与Lagos和Navarro（2023）的结构估计结果基本一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一种新的准备金需求估计方法论框架，填补了简化形式和完全结构化方法之间的空白。2. 展示了如何在保持用户友好性的同时纳入最小必要理论限制。3. 为准备金需求估计提供了更稳健的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了一种更可靠且易于使用的准备金需求估计工具。2. 能够更好地控制管理利率利差变化对准备金需求的影响。3. 估计结果与现有结构模型一致，验证了方法的有效性。

title: Signaling Effects of Government Spending: The Financing Schemes Matter
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of Finance and Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Economics and Management Academy

detail.title: Signaling Effects of Government Spending: The Financing Schemes Matter
detail.abstract: Government spending may affect households not only through expected demand stimulus but also by revealing policymakers' private information about economic fundamentals. We study whether households interpret expansionary fiscal policy as such a signal of weaker future economic fundamentals (signaling effect), and whether the signaling effect depends on how the spending is financed. We first develop a stylized signal-extraction model in which the government chooses both the size of spending and the tax share of financing in response to its private information about underlying conditions. Guided by this model, we conduct a large-scale survey experiment that varies both the size and financing of fiscal expansions. Debt-financed spending leads households to revise expectations pessimistically, lowering expected GDP growth and raising perceived recession risk, while tax-financed spending generates substantially weaker responses. These effects are driven by policy surprises and are concentrated among respondents who believe the government possesses superior information. Consistent with a signaling mechanism, debt-financed expansions also increase perceived economic weakness and reduce willingness to purchase durable goods. A robustness wave using alternative fiscal vignettes confirms these patterns. Our findings provide direct evidence that fiscal policy influences expectations and behavior not only through direct stimulus effects but also through an informational channel shaped by financing choices.

AI.tldr: 政府支出不仅通过需求刺激影响家庭，还通过揭示政策制定者的私人经济信息来影响家庭预期。研究发现债务融资的扩张性财政政策会让家庭对未来经济前景产生悲观预期，而税收融资的政策影响较弱。
AI.research_question: 家庭是否将扩张性财政政策解读为未来经济基本面疲软的信号（信号效应），以及这种信号效应是否取决于支出的融资方式？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注财政政策的需求刺激效应，但忽略了政策可能传递政府关于经济状况的私人信息这一重要渠道。理解财政政策如何通过信息渠道影响家庭预期和行为对政策设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号提取模型：政府根据其私人经济信息选择支出规模和融资方式（税收份额）。家庭从观察到的财政政策中推断政府的私人信息，形成对未来经济状况的预期。
AI.method: 1. 构建理论模型：开发一个简化的信号提取模型，描述政府决策和家庭推断过程；2. 大规模调查实验：通过实验设计，系统性地改变财政扩张的规模和融资方式；3. 稳健性检验：使用替代财政情景进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 债务融资的支出导致家庭悲观预期修正，降低预期GDP增长，提高感知衰退风险；2. 税收融资的支出影响显著较弱；3. 效应主要由政策意外驱动，且集中在认为政府拥有优越信息的受访者中；4. 债务融资扩张增加感知经济疲软，降低耐用消费品购买意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地将财政政策的信号效应与融资方式联系起来；2. 发展了包含政府私人信息和家庭信号提取的理论框架；3. 揭示了财政政策影响预期的信息渠道机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：融资方式选择会影响政策的信息传递效果；2. 债务融资可能产生意外的负面预期效应；3. 在政策沟通中需要考虑信息渠道的影响；4. 为财政政策设计提供了实证依据。

title: Clientelism, Institutions and Sovereign Default
affiliations: SUNY Stony Brook - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Clientelism, Institutions and Sovereign Default

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Papers, volume 26, issue 06, 2026[10.21144/wp26-06]

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Emerging economies exhibit pro-cyclical fiscal policy, counter-cyclical sovereign spreads, and recurrent debt crises, whereas advanced economies sustain high debt with low spreads and lower volatility in outcomes. We document that these differences are systematically related to institutional strength, measured by horizontal accountability, and to the prevalence of clientelistic allocation of public resources in a panel of 51 countries (1994-2023). We develop a dynamic political-economy model of sovereign borrowing with long-term debt in which institutional constraints discipline clientelistic transfers and shape default incentives. Variation in institutional strength generates both emerging-market and developed-economy outcomes within a unified framework and accounts for heterogeneous post-democratization trajectories in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，新兴经济体与发达经济体在财政政策、主权利差和债务危机方面的差异与制度强度（横向问责制）和庇护主义资源配置有关。通过建立包含长期债务的主权借款动态政治经济学模型，作者解释了制度约束如何影响庇护主义转移支付和违约激励，从而产生不同类型经济体的债务模式。
AI.research_question: 为什么新兴经济体表现出顺周期财政政策、反周期主权利差和反复的债务危机，而发达经济体能够维持高债务水平、低利差和较低的结果波动性？这些差异如何与制度强度和庇护主义资源配置相关？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体与发达经济体在债务动态和财政结果方面存在系统性差异，但现有文献缺乏对这些差异背后制度因素的系统性解释。理解制度约束如何影响主权债务决策对于解释不同经济体的债务可持续性和危机模式至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 制度强度理论（横向问责制）
2. 庇护主义政治经济学理论
3. 主权债务违约理论
4. 动态政治经济学模型框架
AI.method:
1. 实证分析：基于51个国家（1994-2023年）的面板数据，检验制度强度（横向问责制）和庇护主义资源配置与财政结果的关系
2. 理论建模：开发包含长期债务的主权借款动态政治经济学模型，分析制度约束如何影响庇护主义转移支付和违约激励
AI.findings:
1. 制度强度（横向问责制）和庇护主义资源配置能够系统性地解释新兴经济体与发达经济体在财政政策、主权利差和债务危机方面的差异
2. 制度约束能够有效约束庇护主义转移支付，从而影响政府的违约激励
3. 制度强度的变化可以解释新兴市场民主化后的异质性发展轨迹
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了统一的理论框架，将新兴市场和发达经济体的债务动态纳入同一模型
2. 阐明了制度约束如何通过影响庇护主义转移支付来塑造主权违约激励
3. 为理解民主化后新兴市场的异质性发展轨迹提供了理论解释
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了改善债务可持续性的制度设计建议
2. 帮助投资者更好地评估不同制度环境下主权债务的风险特征
3. 为国际金融机构设计债务援助方案时考虑制度因素提供了依据

title: When Do Large Language Models Obey? Evidence on Compliance Across Antisocial and Strategic Domains
affiliations: ESSCA school of management and ESSCA School of Management

detail.title: When Do Large Language Models Obey? Evidence on Compliance Across Antisocial and Strategic Domains
detail.abstract: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) submit to experimenter demand effects in economic decisions as humans do? Using GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, and Mistral Large, we conduct two experiments comparing model behavior to established human data and test whether minimal, non-binding authority cues shift choices across antisocial and strategic domains. In Study 1, we replicate the Joy of Destruction game to examine compliance with requests to reduce a partner's payoff at a cost to oneself. Models largely resist explicit verbal requests to harm partners, but destruction rises sharply when the same request is embedded in salient procedural structures, such as a clearly labeled decision stage. Adding a brief justification for the request further increases destruction, yielding the highest compliance rates in the study. In Study 2, we implement a one-shot Prisoner's Dilemma following Gächter et al. (2024). While baseline cooperation resembles human patterns, non-binding advisory requests generate large behavioral shifts toward either cooperation or defection. To compare responsiveness across models with different baseline propensities, we introduce a Normalized Directional Compliance index. This reveals a stable ranking across both domains: Mistral Large is most responsive to authority cues, GPT-4o least responsive, and DeepSeek-V3 intermediate. These findings suggest that algorithmic compliance depends less on the linguistic force of an instruction than on its procedural framing, underscoring a susceptibility to influence that persists even in the absence of persuasive argumentation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在经济决策中会像人类一样受到实验者需求效应的影响，模型对权威线索的响应程度取决于程序性框架而非语言强度，不同模型对权威线索的敏感度存在稳定差异。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在经济决策中是否会像人类一样受到实验者需求效应的影响？不同模型对权威线索的响应程度如何？
AI.motivation: 了解AI系统在决策过程中是否容易被外部权威影响，这对于评估AI系统的自主性和可靠性至关重要，特别是在经济决策等敏感领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实验者需求效应理论、权威影响理论、程序性框架效应、社会心理学中的顺从行为理论
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o、DeepSeek-V3和Mistral Large进行两个实验：研究1复制"破坏的乐趣"游戏，测试模型对减少他人收益请求的响应；研究2实施单次囚徒困境游戏，测试模型对合作/背叛建议的响应。引入标准化方向性顺从指数比较不同模型的响应程度。
AI.findings: 1. 模型基本抵抗明确的言语伤害请求，但当请求嵌入明显的程序性结构时，破坏行为显著增加；2. 添加简短理由进一步增加顺从率；3. 在囚徒困境中，非约束性建议能大幅改变模型行为；4. 不同模型对权威线索的敏感度存在稳定差异：Mistral Large最敏感，GPT-4o最不敏感，DeepSeek-V3居中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次证明LLM在经济决策中会像人类一样受到实验者需求效应影响；2. 提出算法顺从更多取决于程序性框架而非语言强度；3. 揭示了AI系统在缺乏说服性论证时仍存在可被影响的脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI系统设计者提供关于模型易受影响的警示；2. 为评估AI系统自主性提供新方法；3. 为防范AI系统被不当操纵提供实证依据；4. 标准化方向性顺从指数可用于比较不同模型的抗干扰能力。

title: Adversarial Selection
affiliations: Harvard Law School, Buchman Faculty of Law, Tel Aviv University, Tel Aviv University and Tel Aviv University

detail.title: Adversarial Selection
detail.abstract: In many institutional settings, k items are selected with the goal of representing the underlying distribution of claims, opinions, or characteristics in a large population. We study environments with two adversarial parties whose preferences over the selected items are commonly known and opposed. We propose the Quantile Mechanism: one party partitions the population into k disjoint subsets, and the other selects one item from each subset. We show that this procedure is optimally representative among all feasible mechanisms, and illustrate its use in jury selection, multi-district litigation, and committee formation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"分位数机制"的选择方法，用于在对抗性环境中从大群体中选出k个项目以代表整体分布。该方法让一方将群体划分为k个子集，另一方从每个子集中选择一个项目，证明这是最优的代表性机制。
AI.research_question: 在对抗性环境中，如何设计一种机制来从大群体中选择k个项目，使其能最优地代表群体的整体分布？
AI.motivation: 在许多制度环境中，需要从大群体中选择k个项目来代表群体的分布特征（如主张、意见、特征）。当存在两个偏好对立且公开的对抗方时，需要设计一种机制来确保选择结果具有代表性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机制设计理论，研究在对抗性环境中的代表性选择问题。考虑两个偏好对立的参与方，一方负责划分群体，另一方负责从划分中选择项目。
AI.method: 提出"分位数机制"：1）一方将整个群体划分为k个互不相交的子集；2）另一方从每个子集中选择一个项目。通过理论分析证明该机制在所有可行机制中的最优代表性。
AI.findings: 分位数机制在所有可行机制中是最优的代表性机制。该机制能够确保选择结果更好地反映群体的整体分布特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了分位数机制这一新的选择机制；2）证明了该机制在对抗性环境中的最优代表性；3）为代表性选择问题提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）应用于陪审团选择，确保陪审团组成具有代表性；2）应用于多地区诉讼案件，平衡各方利益；3）应用于委员会组建，确保委员会成员构成具有代表性。

title: Labor Market rRgidity and Employment: Firm-Level Evidence
affiliations: University of Ljubljana, University of Marburg - School of Business & Economics, Goethe University Frankfurt and University of Marburg - School of Business & Economics

detail.title: Labor Market rRgidity and Employment: Firm-Level Evidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: We examine the effect of labor market rigidity on firms' employment decisions in OECD countries using a rich firm-level panel dataset covering 164,048 firm-year observations. Exploiting intertemporal variation in country-level employment protection legislation (EPL), we document a trade-off. While stricter EPL reduces the output sensitivity of firms' employment, it simultaneously lowers firms' overall employment levels. Moreover, our evidence indicates that firms respond to increases in EPL by substituting labor with additional investment in net assets, particularly in labor-intensive industries. Overall, our findings suggest that the level of EPL materially affects firm behavior and that governments should carefully consider the associated trade-offs when designing labor market policies.

AI.tldr: 研究使用OECD国家164,048个企业年度观测数据，发现就业保护法规(EPL)存在权衡：更严格的EPL降低企业就业对产出的敏感性，但同时也降低企业总体就业水平。企业通过增加净资产投资替代劳动力来应对EPL提高，特别是在劳动密集型行业。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场刚性如何影响OECD国家企业的雇佣决策？
AI.motivation: 劳动力市场政策对企业和经济有重要影响，但就业保护法规(EPL)对企业雇佣决策的具体影响机制和权衡关系尚需实证研究，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场刚性理论、雇佣调整成本理论、要素替代理论，分析EPL如何通过调整成本影响企业雇佣决策和要素配置。
AI.method: 使用OECD国家企业层面面板数据(164,048个企业年度观测)，利用国家层面就业保护法规(EPL)的跨期变化进行识别分析。
AI.findings: 1. 更严格的EPL降低企业就业对产出的敏感性；2. 同时降低企业总体就业水平；3. 企业通过增加净资产投资替代劳动力应对EPL提高；4. 在劳动密集型行业中这种替代效应更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了EPL对企业雇佣决策的双重影响机制，丰富了劳动力市场刚性理论，提供了要素替代视角下的微观证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议在设计劳动力市场政策时需权衡就业保护与就业水平的关系，考虑企业可能通过资本替代劳动来应对严格法规。

title: Supplementary Information for Submission to Consultation on Streamlining and Simplifying IP Regulation: Exclusive Licensees and Patent Marking
affiliations: King’s College London

detail.title: Supplementary Information for Submission to Consultation on Streamlining and Simplifying IP Regulation: Exclusive Licensees and Patent Marking

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported, in part, by a Novo Nordisk Foundation International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme grant (Inter-CeBIL Programme, grant no. NNF23SA0087056).

detail.abstract:
I’m delighted that IP Australia is continuing to streamline and simplify its laws and procedures. I hope that my submission is useful. I am available to discuss any aspect of my submission.

I have researched two topics addressed in this consultation. I have answered the relevant questions in the form and am providing additional information here. I’ll summarise the two papers I have published, one on each topic. The first concerns expanding the definition of ‘exclusive licensee’ and the second concerns patent numbers and virtual marking.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了IP澳大利亚法律程序简化中的两个具体问题：扩大"独占被许可人"定义以及专利号码和虚拟标记问题
